conditional_criteria: Elementary teachers should hold an elementary (K-6) license and must spend at least 30 percent of their time teaching science or mathematics.; Applicants are required to have completed three years of teaching in a NC public school prior to the application date.
documents_required: Application Files; Principal Letter of Evaluation; Logic Models; Budget

name: LAS Passion Award
summary: The LAS Passion Award recognises an individual for outstanding contributions to the library profession or the Library Association of Singapore through activities such as innovation, outreach, leadership, community involvement, mentoring, and promotion of the profession. The award comes with S$500.
conditional_criteria: Personal membership in LAS (associate or professional)
documents_required: application form; required supporting documents

name: Fulbright Northern Territory Scholarship
provider: Northern Territory Government, Charles Darwin University, and Menzies School of Health Research
summary: The Fulbright Northern Territory Scholarship supports postgraduate, postdoctoral, and scholar applicants in conducting research relevant to the Northern Territory and building international research links with the United States. The award provides a monthly stipend, travel allowance, settling-in allowance, and health benefits.
conditional_criteria: Must not have already commenced this project in the U.S.; Must not have held a J1 or J2 visa in the 24 months before program commences.; Must have a letter of invitation from proposed host institution.; Must be associated with an institution in the Northern Territory that will benefit from the proposed Fulbright program.; Visiting Student Researchers: Must be enrolled in a postgraduate degree at an Australian institution and not complete their degree prior to completion of Fulbright program.; Postdoctoral applicants: PhD must have been conferred in the past 5 years at the time of the application.
documents_required: Award statement

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
provider: Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS)
summary: The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships provide funding for international researchers and artists to pursue research or further studies in Switzerland. The programme encourages international exchange and research cooperation between Switzerland and over 180 countries.
conditional_criteria: Research scholarships require the application to be backed by an academic supervisor in Switzerland who is willing to direct and guide the proposed research.; Art scholarships are open to students wishing to pursue an initial Master's degree in an artistic field and available to students from a limited number of countries only.

name: NASA Postdoctoral Program
summary: The NASA Postdoctoral Program provides fellowships for postdoctoral and senior researchers to conduct research at NASA Centers and associated facilities. Fellows work on specific research opportunities in collaboration with NASA advisors.
conditional_criteria: Non-U.S. Citizens must meet Visa requirements.; Postdoctoral Fellows must submit doctoral degree transcripts and one reference must be from their thesis advisor.; Astrobiology Program accepts applications only during the March and November rounds.
documents_required: Application; Three letters of recommendation; Research proposal; Official doctoral degree transcripts

name: UTokyo Amgen Scholars Program
summary: The UTokyo Amgen Scholars Program provides undergraduate students from across the Asia region with an eight-week summer biomedical research experience in basic and translational sciences. Scholars receive fully funded accommodation, economy-class airfare, and a stipend to support their participation in research projects at the University of Tokyo.
conditional_criteria: Must be attending colleges or universities across the Asia region that award a bachelor’s degree (or its equivalent).; Must have completed at least their first year of undergraduate study at the time the summer program begins.; Must not be graduating before the summer program begins, and will resume undergraduate studies for at least 1 semester or 1 quarter after the summer program ends.; Must have a good working knowledge of English (demonstrated by TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge English, or TOEIC scores) if not a native English speaker or if English is not their first language.
documents_required: Portrait photo; Personal Identification; Academic Transcript; Proof of English proficiency; Latest CV; Letters of Recommendation

name: NTU-University Scholars Programme
summary: The NTU-University Scholars Programme is an academically rigorous, multi-disciplinary undergraduate signature programme that complements core areas of study with interdisciplinary courses, global learning opportunities, and leadership development. It offers scholars immersive cultural experiences, overseas programmes, and scholarship benefits.
conditional_criteria: Must have strong academic credentials, demonstrate leadership potential, and possess outstanding co-curricular records.

name: DOE CSGF
summary: The Department of Energy Computational Science Graduate Fellowship (DOE CSGF) provides four years of support for students pursuing a Ph.D. in engineering, physical, computer, mathematical, or life sciences at an accredited U.S. university. It is open to U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents who plan full-time, uninterrupted study.
conditional_criteria: Current master's students must enroll at a different institution for Ph.D. studies to begin the fall term coincident with the start of DOE CSGF funding.; Second-year or beyond graduate students are not eligible.; Students pursuing a concurrent professional doctoral degree are not eligible.

name: Graduate Diversity Enrichment Program
summary: The Graduate Diversity Enrichment Program provides $5,000 over two years to PhD students enrolled in North Carolina institutions of higher education to support science and research enrichment experiences. Up to ten awards will be granted for the 2025-2027 period.
conditional_criteria: Applicants must be nominated by an advisor at a degree-granting institution in North Carolina.; Applicants must be within the last semester of their 2nd year as a doctoral student at the time of the application and should not be within any more than their 4th year of study.
documents_required: advisor letter; project plan; Progress Report; Financial Report

name: DEVCOM Army Research Laboratory Research Associateship Program (RAP)
summary: This page provides application instructions for postdoctoral candidates applying to the DEVCOM Army Research Laboratory Research Associateship Program. Applicants must submit an online application, curriculum vitae, publication lists, reference forms, and transcripts verifying receipt of their postdoctoral degree. Selected candidates will work with an ARL-RAP advisor to write a five to seven page research proposal for review.
conditional_criteria: If selected by an ARL-RAP advisor, you will be asked to work with them to write a five to seven page research proposal
documents_required: Curriculum Vitae; List by title non-published works including doctoral thesis; List by titles published works; Three References Forms; Transcripts; Five- to Seven-Page Proposal

name: Fellows-to-Faculty Award
summary: The Fellows-to-Faculty Award program supports talented early career scientists by facilitating their transition into tenure-track faculty positions, providing a three-year faculty research grant of $600,000 USD and an optional preceding postdoctoral award for up to two years. It focuses on basic science research aligned with SFARI, SCPAB, or SCENE missions.
conditional_criteria: Applicants must not accept a formal offer for a tenure-track faculty position or equivalent before receiving an award notification.; Applicants must not hold substantial federal grant funding as a Principal Investigator (PI), such as an NIH R01, or other PI-level faculty funding.; Applicants must not hold other career development awards that facilitate a transition to an independent research career at the time of application or simultaneously with the Fellows-to-Faculty Award.; Applicants are limited to submitting applications to the Fellows-to-Faculty Award for a maximum of two (2) years.
documents_required: Proposal Narrative; Graphical Abstract; Personnel Biosketch; Personal Statement; Confirmation Letter for Mentored Training Position

name: Simons Postdoctoral Fellowships in Plant Biology
summary: These postdoctoral fellowships support candidates who intend to pursue a career in basic research on fundamental problems in plant biology. The program supports researchers seeking to understand the inner workings of plants at the level of the whole organism or below, welcoming applicants from plant sciences as well as other disciplines such as engineering, computational modeling, theory, chemistry, synthetic biology, and physics.
conditional_criteria: Applicants who have not yet received their Ph.D. but will have it by the award start date are eligible to apply.; Awards can only be issued to U.S. nonprofit research universities or research institutions, and foreign applicants are invited to apply to work with postdoctoral research sponsor(s) in the U.S.
documents_required: Proposal Narrative; Fellow Biosketch; Sponsor Biosketch; Sponsor Other Support; Letters of Reference

name: Globalink Research Award
summary: The Mitacs Globalink Research Award supports research collaborations between Canada and eligible countries through international mobility for senior undergraduate students, graduate students, and postdoctoral fellows. It provides funding for 12 to 48-week research projects conducted under the joint supervision of a home and host professor.
conditional_criteria: Undergraduate students must have finished their second year of studies prior to departure.; Cannot undertake a research project at an institution where they have previously completed a degree.; Cannot undertake a research project in a country where they hold citizenship.; Must be the legal age of majority in Canada (18 years of age or older).
documents_required: research proposal; Mitacs Pre-Departure form; passport copy

name: Powering Innovation Through Global Talent
summary: The Mitacs Accelerate Global Excellence Award provides a competitive funding package of Can$170,000 over two years for exceptional international researchers and Canadians studying abroad to take part in high-impact industrial research collaborations in Canada. The program supports collaborative industrial-based research projects at eligible Canadian academic institutions with a Mitacs-eligible partner organization.
conditional_criteria: Extensions to the 5-year PhD rule are available for parental or medical leave, military service, etc.; Partner organization must be a Canadian for-profit company receiving more than 50 percent of their funds from non-government sources, or an eligible not-for-profit corporation, municipality, or hospital in Canada.; Academic supervisor must be faculty at a Canadian academic institution and eligible to hold Tri-Agency funds.

name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation PhD Scholarship
summary: The Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation PhD Scholarship is designed for doctoral students in the humanities or social sciences whose research addresses key challenges for Canada's future. It supports students enrolled in their first or second year of a PhD program at a Canadian university or a Canadian student at a university outside Canada.
conditional_criteria: International students must be enrolled at a Canadian university.; Canadian students can be enrolled at a Canadian university or a university outside Canada.
deadline_text: from September 1 to November 6, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. (ET).
documents_required: three letters of reference

name: Entrepreneurship International Program
summary: The Mitacs Entrepreneurship International program offers a travel grant of up to $5,000 to Canadian start-ups housed in academic-institution-linked incubators or accelerators. It supports business travel costs for up to two full-time equivalent employees, founders, or owners to connect with host incubators abroad and explore new business development opportunities.
conditional_criteria: Must be a for-profit company; Must be housed for a minimum of three months and maximum of four years in an eligible incubator or accelerator linked to an academic institution
documents_required: Completed and signed application, including travel budget; Signed letter of support from an eligible Canadian incubator or accelerator linked to a Canadian academic institution; Signed letter of acknowledgement from an international host incubator

name: Future computing paradigms Network Plus
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
fields: computer_science; electrical_engineering; chemical_materials_engineering; biology_life_sciences; social_sciences; humanities_arts; business_management; any
summary: This funding opportunity supports the creation of a multidisciplinary Network Plus to initiate UK collaboration in future computing paradigms and provide evidence-based recommendations for UKRI and government. It covers a 60-month project comprising an initial 18-month evidence-gathering and mapping phase followed by a 42-month network phase.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can only apply as 'project co-lead (international)' as part of an application making use of the UKRI-RCN Money Follows Cooperation agreement.
documents_required: expression of interest

name: US Fulbright Program - Open Study/Research Award
career_levels: undergraduate; masters; phd_candidate; postdoc; early_career; mid_career
summary: The US Fulbright Program Open Study/Research Award enables applicants to design their own independent projects and typically work with advisers at foreign universities or other institutes of higher education in approximately 140 countries. The awards fund study and research across various academic disciplines as well as creative and performing arts. Grants may also cover full-time Master's or PhD degree programs depending on the host country and specific award opportunity.
conditional_criteria: Creative and performing arts applicants are required to submit supplementary materials based on their disciplines.
deadline_text: Tuesday October 6, 2026 at 5 pm Eastern Time
documents_required: application components; supplementary materials for creative and performing arts

name: Big Bets Fellowship: Asia-Pacific
summary: The Big Bets Fellowship: Asia-Pacific equips emerging leaders with the mindset and skills needed to advance breakthrough solutions improving the lives of underserved communities in the Asia-Pacific region. The programme brings together a diverse cohort for onboarding, convenings in Bangkok and Bellagio, and an amplification moment in New York City.
conditional_criteria: Applicants must also be members of the Big Bets community to be eligible to apply for the Fellowship; Solutions must encompass countries located in Southeast Asia, East Asia, South Asia, and the Pacific Islands
documents_required: Eligibility Form; Pre-Application Form; Full Application Form

name: Fulbright Professional Scholarship in Australian-American Alliance Studies
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
summary: The Fulbright Professional Scholarship in Australian-American Alliance Studies funds Australian academics and professionals to undertake a 4-month research project in the United States. The scholarship aims to advance contemporary scholarship on Australia-U.S. relations in the priority fields of strategic studies, technology, and innovation.
conditional_criteria: Professional Applicants: PhD not required. Applicants should instead demonstrate experience in sectors associated with the Alliance.; Scholar Applicants: Must have minimum 8-10 years’ experience in field (including PhD program).
documents_required: letter of invitation

name: Simons Graduate Fellowships in Ecology and Evolution
summary: This fellowship provides financial support for students entering U.S.-based Ph.D. programs to perform research in ecology and evolution, with a preference for interdisciplinary research. It covers a maximum of three years of full-time support usable over a five-year period.
conditional_criteria: Individuals who already hold a Ph.D. or other terminal degree in ecology or evolution, or who have enrolled in such a Ph.D. program prior to summer 2026, are not eligible.; Fellowships must be hosted at United States institutions, at a campus within the United States.; Individuals may not receive salary support from this fellowship concurrently with salary support from any other source.
documents_required: Letter of intent (LOI); Project Proposal; Budget and brief budget justification (finalists only)

name: Accelerate International
summary: Accelerate International supports bilateral research collaborations between interns, academic institutions, and partner organizations in Canada and abroad. It funds 4-to-6-month projects enabling Canadian researchers to participate in projects in Mitacs partner countries, and international students to undertake projects in Canada.
conditional_criteria: College students are eligible to participate in Accelerate projects with international travel from Canada; Full-time students and postdoctoral fellows at universities in all countries except those classified as 'Avoid all travel' or 'Avoid non-essential travel' by the Government of Canada; Interns may be Canadian citizens, permanent residents, international students (with a student visa), or international postdoctoral fellows (with a valid work permit)
documents_required: Accelerate proposal; Intern CV; International pre-departure form; Code of Conduct

name: Accelerate Fellowship
summary: The Mitacs Accelerate Fellowship provides long-term funding and research internships for top-ranked master's and PhD students, as well as postdoctoral fellows, dividing their time between academic institutions and partner organizations. Recipients receive an annual stipend and professional development training to gain hands-on career skills on real-world projects.
conditional_criteria: Postdoctoral fellows are eligible if the date of graduation from a PhD program is less than five years to the start date of the project.; Interns must be 18 years old or over.; Interns must not have been employed full-time at the partner organization prior to applying.
documents_required: Accelerate proposal; Intern CV template; Supporting documents as required by your university or province

name: Pivot Fellowship
fields: physics_astronomy; biology_life_sciences; chemistry; earth_climate_sciences; mathematics_statistics; data_science_ai; computer_science
summary: The Pivot Fellowship program supports researchers with a strong track record in their current field to make contributions to a new discipline by embedding them in a mentor's lab for a training year. It provides one year of academic-year salary support, a research and travel allowance for the fellow, and a research fund for the mentor.
conditional_criteria: Fellows must demonstrate that the fellowship will take place in a new discipline, distinct from their current field of study, within astronomy, biology, chemistry, earth sciences, neuroscience, physics or mathematics.; In order to receive the fellowship, fellows must be approved by their institution for a full year of leave.; Fellows must not hold any other fellowship that will provide them with salary support during the training year of the Pivot Fellowship.
documents_required: Scientific Narrative; Summary of Previous Scientific Accomplishments; Curriculum Vitae; Confidential letters of recommendation

name: Azrieli International Postdoctoral Fellowship 2027–28
summary: The Azrieli International Postdoctoral Fellowship supports brilliant international researchers in conducting postdoctoral research in Israel. It provides a basic stipend along with research and travel allowances for a two-year period.
conditional_criteria: Candidates currently enrolled in a PhD program may apply if they complete their dissertation defence successfully no later than June 1, 2027.; Applicants must not have received an academic degree – including undergraduate or graduate degrees – in an Israeli institution.; Applicants who commenced a postdoctoral or an academic position in Israel prior to September 1, 2026, may not apply.; At the time of application, candidates are required to have an academic sponsor, who is a faculty member at an eligible Israeli academic institution.

name: Shenoy Undergraduate Research Fellowship in Neuroscience (SURFiN)
summary: The Shenoy Undergraduate Research Fellowship in Neuroscience (SURFiN) provides paid, in-person undergraduate research assistantships during the academic year to undergraduate students who have not had access to research training opportunities. Fellows work approximately 10 hours a week over 30 weeks in labs within commuting distance in the U.S., Canada, and Europe.
conditional_criteria: Must be able to commute (<1.5 hours) to a SURFiN laboratory for regular in-person lab activity.; Must remain actively enrolled through at least April 15, 2027.; Students on a leave of absence or not actively completing coursework during the 2026-2027 academic year are not eligible.
documents_required: Statement of Interest; Research Experience Summary; Curriculum Vitae or Resume; Official or Unofficial Transcript; Transfer Plans (optional); Letter of Reference; Additional Information (optional)

name: Simons Dissertation Fellowship in Mathematics
summary: The Simons Dissertation Fellowship in Mathematics provides research support to excellent graduate students in the final fourth and fifth years of their Ph.D. studies. The grant offers funding for general research support, departmental discretionary funds, and indirect costs.
conditional_criteria: Applicants must apply in the third year of their Ph.D. program and be in a five-year Ph.D. program.
documents_required: Statement of Research Plans; Letter from Thesis Advisor; Applicant Biosketch

name: Scientific Software Research Faculty Award
summary: The Scientific Software Research Faculty Award provides five years of salary support and a yearly research allowance to support new faculty positions for scientific software-focused researchers in academic departments. The aim is to stimulate core scientific software infrastructure development in mathematics and physical sciences through creating a long-term, faculty-level career path.
conditional_criteria: Applicants with Ph.D.'s in other related fields of science (such as computational atmospheric and ocean science, biophysics, chemical physics, geoscience) may be considered if their proposed computational research is at a mathematical sophistication
documents_required: Research Statement; Scientific Vision Statement; Applicant Biosketch; Host Institution Letter of Support

name: Simons Early Career Investigator in Aquatic Microbial Ecology and Evolution Awards
summary: This award helps launch the careers of outstanding investigators in microbial ecology, microbial biogeochemistry, and microbial evolution in marine or natural freshwater systems. It supports basic research to advance our understanding through fieldwork, experiments, modeling, or theory.
documents_required: LOI Narrative; Full Proposal

name: Simons Postdoctoral Fellowships in Marine Microbial Ecology
summary: This fellowship supports postdoctoral candidates pursuing basic research in marine microbial ecology, emphasizing microorganisms in ocean processes. It is open to researchers with various disciplinary backgrounds, including modeling and theory development, who will be hosted at nonprofit research universities or institutions in the U.S. or Canada.
conditional_criteria: U.S. citizens may choose a postdoctoral research sponsor in either the U.S. or Canada. Foreign applicants may choose a sponsor in the U.S.; Awards can only be issued to nonprofit research universities or research institutions in the U.S. or Canada (in a campus within these countries).
documents_required: Proposal Narrative; Fellow Biosketch; Sponsor Biosketch; Sponsor Other Support; Four Letters of Recommendation

name: NETL Methane Hydrate Fellowships
summary: The NETL Methane Hydrate Fellowships support graduate and postgraduate students pursuing advanced degrees and training in methane hydrate science. It provides stipends, research supply supplements, and travel allowances for tenure at any federal laboratory or accredited university in the United States.
deadline_text: February Review - February 1, August Review - August 1
documents_required: complete contact information for the proposed fellowship Adviser; online application through the NRC Research Associateship Programs application module

name: The Optical Society of America Foundation Fellowships
summary: This fellowship provides career-enhancing experiences to recent PhDs through postdoctoral research at an Optical Society of America Foundation sponsoring company. It funds a one-year position (with possible renewal) involving a stipend, health insurance allowance, and relocation reimbursement.
conditional_criteria: Foreign nationals were to be sponsored under a J-1 visa by the National Academy of Sciences.
documents_required: Application Form; Statement of Purpose; Summary of Previous Research; Scholarly Productivity

name: Fulbright Scholarship in the Operatic Arts
summary: The Fulbright Scholarship in the Operatic Arts supports an emerging Australian artist to undertake advanced artistic practice, research, training, or professional development in the United States in the field of opera and related performing arts disciplines. It provides a monthly stipend, travel allowance, health benefits plan, and visa support.
conditional_criteria: Must have a letter of invitation or affiliation from a proposed U.S. host institution or organisation.; Must not have already commenced this project in the U.S.; Must not have held a J1 or J2 visa in the 24 months before program commences.
documents_required: Letter of invitation or affiliation from a proposed U.S. host institution or organisation

name: Azrieli International Visiting PhD Fellowship
summary: The Azrieli International Visiting PhD Fellowship offers outstanding international PhD candidates the opportunity to conduct short-term research in Israel for four months. The fellowship provides ILS 12,000 per month to support accommodation, international airfare, living costs, fees, and health insurance.
conditional_criteria: Must have secured an academic host who is a faculty member at one of the eligible Israeli institutions; Must not have had prior academic experience in Israel and must not be conducting ongoing research in Israel at the time of application

name: Daiwa Foundation Small Grants and Awards
career_levels: undergraduate; masters; phd_candidate; postdoc; early_career; mid_career; senior; industry
summary: The Daiwa Foundation provides small grants and awards to individuals and institutions in the UK and Japan to promote and support interaction between the two countries. Funding covers all fields of activity, including educational and grassroots exchanges, research travel, conferences, and collaborative projects. Grants range from £2,000 to £18,000 depending on the specific programme strand.
conditional_criteria: Projects that foster gender equality and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals are welcomed.
documents_required: online application form

name: Scholarly Project Funding
summary: Scholarly Project Funding provides small grants of $750 to graduate students at Carnegie Mellon University for costs incurred in completing research required for a graduate degree. The funding supports research-related expenses when personal or departmental resources are exhausted.
conditional_criteria: Doctoral students in 'In Absentia' status are not eligible for funding.; Students are limited to one grant per fiscal year (July 1 – June 30) in which they are enrolled as a graduate student.; Students must be enrolled during the semesters they use the funding.; The project, research, or product in question must be at least a portion of a graduate degree requirement.; The work in question must be scheduled for start-up within one semester of application for the award.
documents_required: Student Application Form; Advisor Support Form; Proposal budget; Research statement

name: Emerging Scholars Network
summary: The Emerging Scholars Network is a three-quarter cohort program for mid-stage doctoral students who have advanced to candidacy. It provides a $2000 stipend each quarter alongside workshops, peer accountability, and guidance to support research productivity and timely degree completion.

name: Scholarships for outstanding international undergraduate students (science and engineering only)
summary: This scholarship aims to support international undergraduate students in science and engineering by providing full or half tuition equivalent support for outstanding students. The award is based on entrance examination performance or academic performance in the previous academic year.
conditional_criteria: Must be enrolled in science and engineering after April 2020; Must not have exceeded the standard duration of undergraduate studies; Must not be receiving a scholarship equivalent to tuition fees for the purpose of tuition support; Spring semester GPA must not be less than 3.0 to avoid suspension in the fall semester
deadline_text: Tuesday, April 7, 2026 to Friday, April 17, 2026, 3 p.m.

name: Conference Grant
summary: The Conference Grant supports conference-related expenses including registration, travel, and lodging for MIT graduate students presenting original research or serving as panelists. Up to one grant is awarded per student per fiscal year with a maximum of $1000 for in-person conferences or $500 for virtual ones.
conditional_criteria: Must present original research or serve as a panelist at the conference; Must be enrolled as a student at MIT at the time of the conference
documents_required: personal statement; recommendation letter; conference proceeding copy; original receipts

name: Collaborate with the UK Human Functional Genomics Initiative
summary: This funding opportunity provides Academic and Industry Partnership awards to support feasibility, pilot, or initial studies that build collaborations between industrial partners and the UK Human Functional Genomics Initiative. It funds direct project costs and networking activities such as staff time and travel. Eligible applicants must be based at a UK research organisation and be a researcher eligible for Medical Research Council (MRC) funding.
conditional_criteria: Industrial partners will be expected to provide matched funding (cash, in-kind or both).
documents_required: application form

name: MIT Grant for Graduate Students with Children (GGSC)
summary: The MIT Grant for Graduate Students with Children (GGSC) provides need-blind and supplemental need-based financial assistance to eligible full-time graduate student parents at MIT. The funds help alleviate expenses such as child care, health care, and housing.
conditional_criteria: Child must reside with the student at least half-time throughout the year and be under 18 or still enrolled in K-12 education.; Students on medical leave are not eligible to apply until their return to enrolled status.; Students in specific professional programs identified by the Office of the Provost are not eligible.; Students in F-1 student status on post-completion Optional Practical Training or STEM Optional Practical Training Extension, as well as students in J-1 student status on post-completion Academic Training are not eligible.
deadline_text: The application is only open until September 30th
documents_required: Copy of the child(ren)’s birth certificate(s) or U.S. passport(s); Health insurance documents; Court documents showing proof of legal guardianship; Federal or state tax returns claiming the child(ren) as dependents; MIT Form I-20 or DS-2019 (for international students); I-94 confirming F-1 or J-1 student status (for international students); MIT Dependent Forms I-20 or DS-2019 for children (for international students)

name: Resident Faculty Scholar
summary: The Resident Faculty Scholar Grant Program supports a faculty member, or small groups of faculty members, at institutions in the United States or Canada to utilize BWF Headquarters as a site for mini-sabbaticals or project incubation. It provides dedicated protected time to initiate or accelerate their work when aligned with BWF priorities and goals for a duration of two to six months.
documents_required: Resident Scholars Signature Page; Resident Scholars Budget Form; RFS Institutional Certification Form; Request for Proposal

name: Anti-Black Racism Initiative Recruitment Awards
summary: The Anti-Black Racism Initiative Recruitment Awards offer financial support to Black applicants admitted to graduate degree programs at McGill University. The awards range from $2,500 to $10,000 depending on the degree program (PhD, Master's Thesis, or Master's Non-thesis) and are non-renewable.
conditional_criteria: Must self-identify as Black during the admissions process.; Must intend to register full-time in their degree program during their first year of study.

name: Fulbright AUS Postdoctoral Scholarship
summary: The Fulbright AUS Postdoctoral Scholarship provides financial support for Australian postdoctoral researchers to undertake research programs in the United States that enhance bilateral relations. The award offers a monthly stipend, travel allowance, and settling-in allowance for a duration of 6 to 8 months.
conditional_criteria: Exceptions may apply for residency at the time of application.; Applicants may be in their final year of their PhD research if applying for a postdoctoral award, but PhD must be conferred before commencing program.; Must have a letter of invitation from proposed host institution.
documents_required: Letter of invitation from proposed host institution

name: Chiu-Kay Lui CSC Fellowships
summary: The Chiu-Kay Lui CSC Fellowships support Chinese scholars holding a China Scholarship Council scholarship who are pursuing doctoral degrees in STEM, Medicine and Health Sciences, and specific areas of research in Law at McGill University. The award provides $16,000 to cover the international fee differential and is renewable for up to 3 years.
conditional_criteria: Must hold a China Scholarship Council (CSC) scholarship; Must be admitted to or registered in a doctoral degree program in specific faculties/units at McGill; For Law applicants, only research in technology, business, or agricultural law is eligible
documents_required: Application form; Letter of support from the supervisor; Curriculum vitae; Official/certified copies of all post-secondary transcripts; One half page (in English) with research project title, supervisor's name, and short lay summary; One half page handwritten in Chinese with basic information and academic studies goal

name: Dr. Joanne Jepson Fellowship
fields: agriculture_food; medicine_clinical; electrical_engineering; mechanical_aerospace_engineering; civil_environmental_engineering; chemical_materials_engineering; biology_life_sciences; biomedical_sciences
summary: The Dr. Joanne Jepson Fellowship supports exceptional Canadian Indigenous students pursuing graduate degrees in STEM or Health-related disciplines at McGill University. It provides funding for Master's and PhD students depending on their program type and level.
conditional_criteria: Master's applicants must be M1, while doctoral applicants must be PhD1 to PhD3; Must be registered in or admitted to graduate degree programs in Agricultural and Environmental Sciences, Dental Medicine and Oral Health Sciences, Engineering, Medicine and Health Sciences, Science, Biological and Biomedical Engineering, Integrated
documents_required: The application form; A letter of support from the department/supervisor; Curriculum vitae; Official/certified copies of all post-secondary transcripts

name: Bullitt Prize
summary: The Bullitt Prize is a $100,000 unrestricted award split over two years for emerging academic, professional, and/or grassroots leaders working on conservation or environmental justice issues. It invests in the leader themselves to support their vision, living expenses, academic/tuition expenses, and project implementation.
conditional_criteria: From an underrepresented group, such as an economically disadvantaged group
documents_required: Current resume; Brief description of who you are; Responses to three prompts to describe your project, vision, and goals

name: Daiwa Foundation Small Grants
summary: Grants of £2,000 to £9,000 are available to individuals and organisations in the UK or Japan to support travel and interaction between the two countries. The funding primarily covers flights and subsistence costs for projects across all fields of activity, excluding regular or continuing events.
documents_required: online application form

name: Shoucheng Zhang Graduate Fellowship
fields: physics_astronomy; chemical_materials_engineering; electrical_engineering; computer_science; earth_climate_sciences; mathematics_statistics; mechanical_aerospace_engineering
summary: The Shoucheng Zhang Graduate Fellowship supports outstanding incoming doctoral students pursuing innovative, interdisciplinary research in the broad field of quantum science and engineering. The award provides a stipend plus tuition support for up to 3 years.
conditional_criteria: Students must be nominated by an eligible degree program to be considered for a Zhang fellowship.; Research must be focused on the broad field of quantum science and engineering.

name: SIGF: Stanford Interdisciplinary Graduate Fellowship
summary: The Stanford Interdisciplinary Graduate Fellowship (SIGF) awards three-year fellowships to outstanding doctoral students at Stanford University who are engaged in novel, cutting-edge interdisciplinary research that crosses traditional disciplinary boundaries. The award provides stipend support alongside tuition coverage for eligible doctoral students.
conditional_criteria: Applicants must be currently in the first three years of a doctoral program at Stanford University.; Students with a nationally competitive fellowship or other external fellowship that can be supplemented by the SIGF are eligible to apply.
documents_required: Interdisciplinary research statement; Abstract (100 words); Curriculum vitae; Stanford Unofficial Transcript

name: School of Graduate Studies Research-Stream Programs Funding
summary: This funding program provides financial support for research-stream master's and PhD students at the University of Toronto to help offset the cost of their education and earn income. It ensures every eligible student has access to a basic funding level through their supervisor, department, and/or Faculty.
conditional_criteria: Funding availability, composition, sources, and amount depend on specific Faculty and graduate unit decisions.

name: MIT Sloan PhD Program
summary: The MIT Sloan PhD Program offers a comprehensive funding package including tuition, medical insurance, and a stipend for students in good academic standing. It also provides a new laptop computer and a conference travel/research budget.
conditional_criteria: Video statement required for Accounting only; Video statement optional for Marketing and System Dynamics
documents_required: Online application; Statement of purpose; Three letters of recommendation; Transcripts; English proficiency exam scores; GRE or GMAT scores; Resume; Video statement (for Accounting only)

name: Doctoral Research Awards
summary: The Cancer Research Society's Doctoral Research Awards Program supports students involved in innovative cancer research projects at Canadian universities. The award provides $70,000 over 2 years to help young researchers develop their skills and advance knowledge about cancer.

name: Jennings Family Brave Companions Fund
summary: The Jennings Family Brave Companions Fund provides up to $10,000 to eligible Carnegie Mellon undergraduates enrolled in formal study, research, or service abroad programs in emerging countries during the summer. Awardees must complete a service-based or research-based follow-on project upon completion of their study abroad program.
conditional_criteria: Preference is given to students who have overcome obstacles such as socioeconomic or educational disadvantage or disabilities.; Preference is given to students who have demonstrated a commitment to the advancement of groups who have traditionally faced barriers to study abroad.; Preference is given to students who have demonstrated financial need.; Preference is given to students who have not previously had a study or travel abroad experience.
documents_required: Initial application; Experience Report; Letter of Agreement; Pre-departure registration materials

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarships-Master’s (CGRS-M) Program
provider: Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR), Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC), Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Research Council of Canada (SSHRC)
summary: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarships-Master’s (CGRS-M) Program supports outstanding graduate students in developing their research skills at eligible Canadian universities. It provides funding for one year to master's or doctoral level students studying health sciences, natural sciences and engineering, or social sciences and humanities.
conditional_criteria: Meritorious CGRS M applicants who self-identify as Black may be selected to receive designated funding for Black student researchers.; Meritorious Indigenous students (First Nations, Inuit and Métis) whose nations or communities are located in Canada may be eligible for the Indigenous Scholars Supplement or Indigenous Scholars Award.
documents_required: Canadian Common CV (CCV); Transcripts

name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship
summary: The Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS) program provides merit-based scholarships to support domestic and international graduate students pursuing master's or doctoral studies at publicly-assisted universities in Ontario. Jointly funded by the Province of Ontario and the University of Toronto, the award provides $5,000 per session for two or three consecutive sessions.
conditional_criteria: International students must hold valid study permits effective as of the graduate units’ OGS international application deadline.; Must be registered or intend to register in an eligible program on a full-time basis in 2026-2027.; Must not have exceeded the lifetime maximum of government-funded support or maximum OGS/QEII support available for their current level of study.
documents_required: OGS application form; Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions; Previous awards/publications/conference/research experience; Plan of study; Two academic references

name: SGS Conference Grant
summary: The SGS Conference Grant provides financial support to cover the minimum registration fee for eligible master's and doctoral students actively presenting their research at virtual or in-person academic conferences. Master's and PhD students may collect up to three grants per graduate degree program.
conditional_criteria: Must be presenting at a conference scheduled to occur during the current open application cycle’s window of eligibility; Must be actively presenting their own research relevant to their current thesis; Where travel is required, have registered travel dates through the U of T Safety Abroad website before applying and prior to departure (exempt for travel within Canada)
documents_required: Email confirmation of registration with Safety Abroad Office (if traveling internationally); Details of the academic conference; Details regarding the presentation; Proof of conference presentation; Registration fee invoice showing the amount paid

name: LEAP Program
summary: The Tohoku University Advanced Graduate School LEAP Program provides a comprehensive support package for doctoral students, including incentive stipends, tuition waivers, and research grant support. It aims to cultivate outstanding researchers with global perspectives and strong societal problem-solving skills.
conditional_criteria: Not fall under the restrictions on simultaneous awards.; Not have exceeded the standard period of study.; Not be on a leave of absence.

name: School of Graduate Studies University-Wide Awards
provider: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto
summary: The School of Graduate Studies offers between 15 to 20 awards annually through its University-Wide Awards competition for current graduate students based on academic merit and/or financial need. Applicants must be currently registered in a full-time U of T graduate degree program at the Master's or Doctoral level.
conditional_criteria: Must meet award-specific eligibility criteria such as academic merit, financial need, student citizenship, or area of research.
documents_required: personal statement; Curriculum Vitae (CV); Plan of Study / Research Proposal; financial need assessment (if applicable)

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship-Doctoral (CGRS D) Program
provider: Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR), Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC), Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
summary: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship-Doctoral (CGRS D) Program supports and promotes research excellence in health, natural sciences and engineering, and social sciences and humanities. It provides $40,000 per year for 36 months to allow doctoral scholars to focus fully on their studies and contribute to the Canadian research ecosystem.
conditional_criteria: SSHRC applicants who have completed more than 36 months are no longer eligible.; Must not hold a tenure or tenure-track appointment concurrently for CIHR or NSERC.
deadline_text: Not for students: Oct 1, 2026 (CIHR and NSERC) ; Oct 15, 2026 (SSHRC)
documents_required: Transcripts; Online application form; Supporting letters from references

name: Purchase mid-range equipment for biomedical research: MRC Equip
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants ranging from £200,000 to £1,000,000 to purchase mid-range capital equipment that enables and enhances biomedical research within the MRC's remit. It is open to eligible researchers and research technical professionals employed at UK research organisations and select MRC Units.
conditional_criteria: Must be employed at a UK research organisation eligible for MRC funding or eligible MRC Units (such as The Gambia at LSHTM, MRC/UVRI and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit).; Limit of two applications per research organisation.; Project lead can only be named on one application as project lead.; Equipment cost must be between £200,000 and £1,000,000 (including VAT).
documents_required: Quotes for the equipment

name: Graduate Mobility Award
summary: The Graduate Mobility Award encourages graduate students to study and conduct research abroad as part of their McGill degree program by defraying part of the cost of the international experience. It is available to all full-time graduate degree program students at McGill to support mobility activities such as fieldwork, research stays, and workshops that contribute to thesis completion.
conditional_criteria: For thesis students, must have completed an advisory committee meeting within 10 months of travel.; FRQ Scholarship holders that are not Canadian citizens or permanent residents of Canada must also submit the Out-of-Quebec Short Stay declaration form.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, excluding blackout periods (April 15-May 15 and July 15-August 15). Applications must be submitted at least 8 weeks before the start date of travel
documents_required: GMA application form; Supervisor letter of support; Out-of-Quebec Short Stay declaration form (if applicable)

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship Doctoral (CGRS D)
summary: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarships - Doctoral (CGRS D) Program provides financial support to eligible doctoral students at Canadian institutions funded by CIHR, NSERC, and SSHRC. The award offers $40,000 per year for 3 years.
conditional_criteria: Non-Canadians not holding protected persons status must be registered in their doctoral program for Fall 2026.; Non-Canadian applicants not holding permanent residence or protected person status must be enrolled in their doctoral program of study at an eligible Canadian institution at the time of application.
documents_required: All UP TO DATE official university transcripts; CIHR signature pages (3 pages)

name: Provincial Agency - FRQ - Awards
summary: The Fonds de recherche du Québec (FRQ) awards provide funding for Master's, Doctoral, and Postdoctoral students studying in eligible research programs in Québec. Master's awards offer $20,000 per year for up to 6 semesters, while Doctoral awards offer $25,000 per year for up to 12 semesters.
conditional_criteria: International and out-of-province students are eligible to apply as of Fall of their first year in their eligible research program.; Canadian citizens or Canadian permanent residents without a RAMQ card must submit proof of admission to a master's or doctoral program at a Québec university or an acceptance of supervision form.; Master's award applicants in SC Sector must meet a minimum CGPA of 3.7/4.00.
deadline_text: Doctoral application deadline: September 29, 2026 at 16h00 EST; Masters application deadline: October 1, 2026 at 16h00 EST
documents_required: FRQ application details FORM; Proof of admission or acceptance of supervision form (if applicable)

name: SGS Research Travel Grant
provider: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto
summary: The SGS Research Travel Grant provides supplemental financial support to eligible PhD and SJD students in the Humanities or Social Sciences pursuing research travel necessary for their degree. It helps cover travel destinations and durations outside of commuting distance.
conditional_criteria: Must be registered in the Humanities (Division 1) or Social Sciences (Division 2); Must be conducting research necessary for the completion of their thesis; Must have registered their travel dates through the U of T Safety Abroad website if traveling outside Canada; First-year PhD and SJD students and Flexible-time PhD students are ineligible
documents_required: Email confirmation of registration with Safety Abroad Office if traveling internationally; Details of the travel; Proposed budget for the travel; Purpose of the research; Proof of transportation; Final Report Form upon return

name: Operating grants
summary: The Operating Grant program from the Cancer Research Society funds research projects in Canada that advance essential knowledge to better prevent, detect, and treat all types of cancer. Grants provide up to $140,000 over 2 years to support researchers whose work accelerates the discovery of concrete and innovative solutions.
documents_required: Letter of intent; Full application

name: Strengthening Mothers through Perinatal Research Award
summary: This award provides $1,500 to graduate students at the University of British Columbia pursuing research into woman-centered, holistic, and physiologic maternity care. There is a strong preference for midwives or nurses pursuing graduate work.
conditional_criteria: Strong preference for this award to go to a midwife or nurse pursuing graduate work.
documents_required: Cover page; Outline of proposed research; CV; Letter of support

name: Doctoral Completion Award (DCA)
summary: The Doctoral Completion Award (DCA) provides financial assistance for full-time PhD and SJD students in the final stage of their program who are beyond the funded cohort but still within the time limit for the degree. The award is managed locally by individual graduate faculties and units.
conditional_criteria: beyond the funded cohort as established by graduate unit practice; within time limit for the degree; in good academic standing as defined by the graduate unit; A financial needs assessment may be required for some applications.
documents_required: Application

name: Canada / Foreign Government Awards - Mexico
summary: The Government of Mexico offers scholarships to Canadian students and Postdocs wishing to pursue studies or research at participating Mexican institutions. The award covers round trip airfare, domestic transportation, tuition, language course fees, a monthly living allowance, health insurance, and visa costs.
conditional_criteria: Must be accepted in a program of the participating post-secondary Mexican institutions.; Must have completed the prerequisite degrees for the proposed program of study at the time of submitting an application.

name: Canada-US Fulbright Program
summary: The Canada-US Fulbright Program enables Canadian graduate students to conduct research, lecture, or enroll in formal academic programs in the United States. Successful applicants receive funding along with visa and basic health insurance support.
conditional_criteria: Cannot have significant recent experience in the United States; Cannot be dual citizens of the US; Cannot be enrolled at a US university; May not have held a previous Fulbright student award

name: Canada Research Training Awards Suite – Research Travel Supplements (CRTAS-RTS)
summary: This funding opportunity supports high-calibre Canadian graduate students in building global linkages and international networks through the pursuit of exceptional research experiences abroad. Each supplement is valued at $9,000 non-renewable and is awarded on a first-come, first-served basis.
conditional_criteria: Must not have held or be currently holding a Canada Graduate Scholarships – Michael Smith Foreign Study Supplements (CGS-MSFSS); Must not hold a CRTAS-RTS more than once
documents_required: CRTAS-RTS Application Form; Travel documents; Award notice

name: Delta Kappa Gamma World Fellowships
summary: The Delta Kappa Gamma World Fellowships provide funding opportunities for international women to pursue graduate studies in Canada and the United States, specifically supporting professional and personal growth in education. The award offers $4,000 USD for one year to eligible master's and doctoral students at the University of Toronto.
conditional_criteria: Preference is given to candidates who plan to return to and create an impact within their home countries.
documents_required: PDF application form; Status of Degree Work page; Copy of a valid study permit; Scans of original or certified/validated copies of up-to-date official transcripts from all previous post-secondary stud; University of Toronto official transcript; Professional resume or curriculum vitae (optional)

name: Fulbright Student and Scholar Awards
summary: The Canada-U.S. Fulbright Program provides opportunities for outstanding Canadian students, prospective graduate students, junior professionals, and faculty to study, conduct research, or lecture in the United States. Student awards support one year of research or fieldwork, while faculty awards offer the chance to focus on research and writing during sabbatical.
documents_required: online application packages

name: Scholars-at-Risk Fellowship
provider: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto
summary: The Scholars-at-Risk Fellowship provides financial support of up to $10,000 for one year and Massey College membership to eligible current or incoming master's and doctoral students at the University of Toronto. It is designed for graduate students who have recently been asylum/refugee seekers or whose studies have been impacted by changing political environments.
conditional_criteria: Must have been within the last 5 years, an asylum/refugee seeker anywhere in the world, OR have their current or proposed program of study impacted by changing political environments in their country of current or future study, including changes in i; Must demonstrate financial need through the completion of a financial need assessment form.; Must demonstrate a commitment to enhancing the student experience of their peers through university or community outreach and involvement.
documents_required: Completed online application form; Personal Statement of Intent; Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions; Curriculum vitae; Copy of University of Toronto Offer of Admission letter; Proof of asylum/refugee seeker status; Completed SGS Financial Need Assessment Form; One (1) Confidential Letter of Reference

name: Fulbright AUS Postgraduate Scholarship (Master's Degree)
summary: The Fulbright AUS Postgraduate Scholarship provides funding for Australian citizens to undertake a Master's degree in the United States. The award supports research programs that enhance bilateral relations and includes a monthly stipend, airfares, and tuition allowances.
conditional_criteria: Applicants may be in their final year of study if applying for a postgraduate degree award, provided they complete their undergraduate degree before commencing their program.; Exceptions to residing in Australia at the time of application may apply.

name: Montreal Council on Foreign Relations Doctoral Fellowship
summary: This fellowship provides $25,000 for doctoral students at McGill University to conduct research abroad related to international relations for a non-renewable period of four or more months.
documents_required: Application form; Academic Curriculum vitae; Description of the research project with bibliography; All official University level transcripts; Four letters of recommendation

name: AIA Scholarships
summary: The AIA Scholarships provide HK$50,000 annually throughout undergraduate studies for local full-time Year 1 students in Hong Kong. The award recognizes academic excellence and community service.
conditional_criteria: Where candidates are of equal merit, priority will be given to students from families experiencing financial difficulty
documents_required: application form; supporting documents

name: Mitacs Globalink
summary: Mitacs Globalink offers travel funding between Canada and academic institutions abroad for senior undergraduates, graduate students, and postdocs. The award provides $6,000 per unit of travel for a single travel period of 12 to 24 weeks.
conditional_criteria: Trainees cannot travel to a country where they hold citizenship unless they also hold Canadian citizenship or are Canadian Permanent Residents.; FRQ Scholarship holders that are not Canadian citizens or permanent residents of Canada must submit the Out-of-Quebec Short Stay declaration form.
documents_required: Globalink Intention to Apply form; Research Funding Checklist; Out-of-Quebec Short Stay declaration form (for applicable FRQ Scholarship holders)

name: PhD Degree Funding
summary: The Harvard Kenneth C. Griffin Graduate School of Arts and Sciences offers incoming PhD students a comprehensive package of financial support including tuition, health insurance fees, and basic living expenses. This support consists of a combination of tuition grants, stipends, traineeships, teaching fellowships, research assistantships, and other academic appointments.
conditional_criteria: Must maintain continued full-time enrollment; Must maintain satisfactory academic progress as certified by department and academic advisor on a term-by-term basis; Annually renew or activate funding for the upcoming year

name: Provost’s Postdoctoral Fellowship Program
summary: The University of Toronto Provost’s Postdoctoral Fellowship program provides funding to Graduate Faculties to increase opportunities for hiring postdoctoral fellows from underrepresented groups, specifically Indigenous and Black researchers. Each award provides $80,000 per year to support up to two years of a postdoctoral fellowship salary and employer costs, plus a start-up stipend.
conditional_criteria: Must identify as Indigenous and/or Black researchers; Must be nominated by prospective Faculties/divisions
documents_required: nomination letter from the graduate unit/department Chair; supervisor statement; Research or scholarship proposal; Training statement; Nominee's C.V.; short personal biography

name: Schmidt Science Fellows Award
fields: physics_astronomy; biology_life_sciences; chemistry; earth_climate_sciences; chemical_materials_engineering; mechanical_aerospace_engineering; civil_environmental_engineering; electrical_engineering; computer_science; mathematics_statistics
summary: The Schmidt Science Fellows program provides a personal stipend for up to two years of postdoctoral study in a different area from the applicant's PhD, at any approved location worldwide. It aims to break down barriers to interdisciplinary science and support the next generation of science leaders.
conditional_criteria: Individuals on clinical track MD-PhD or Veterinary-PhD programs are not eligible.
documents_required: Nomination letter; Description of PhD; Fellowship Research Plan: The Pivot; Options for Placement; Collaboration Statement; Personal Statement; Lay Summaries and Impact Statement; Up to date CV; Up to date transcripts; Reference Letters

name: PATT travel grants for competitively awarded observation time 2026
summary: This grant funds travel and subsistence costs in support of competitively awarded science observation time at astronomy facilities for UK-based observers. The funding covers two-year travel grants for groups with travel costs of more than £7,500 a year.
conditional_criteria: Must be the project lead or project co-lead, or a nominated representative; Must be a member of academic or research staff at the institution of the project lead; Must be a student attached to the institution of the project lead whose credentials have firmly established them as a bona fide observer; Students undertaking observations as part of their PhD preparation are not eligible for travel funds
documents_required: Expenditure breakdown template

name: Emergency Hardship Funding
summary: This programme provides temporary financial relief grants up to $2,500 for PhD and master's students at Harvard Griffin GSAS who experience unexpected emergencies or financial hardship. It covers unanticipated expenses such as medical costs, immediate family emergency travel, or displacement by natural disasters.
conditional_criteria: Must be currently enrolled in a Harvard Griffin GSAS PhD or master's program.; Students on a leave of absence or enrolled at another Harvard school as part of a combined degree program are ineligible.; Students enrolled in Harvard AB/AM, AB/SM, and MS/MBA master's programs are ineligible.
documents_required: Request for Emergency Hardship Funding form; Documentation of incurred expenses

name: Promoting Innovation in Science and Mathematics
summary: The Promoting Innovation in Science and Mathematics awards provide funds for materials, equipment, and supplies related to implementing high-quality STEM curriculum and activities in the classroom. The award provides up to $3,000 for one year, with an optional additional $1,500 for related professional development, for eligible K-12 teaching professionals.
conditional_criteria: Must currently be employed at a K-12 public school (including charters) in North Carolina; Must hold a professional educator's license to teach in a North Carolina K-12 public school
documents_required: Signature Page

name: Fulbright Postgraduate Scholarship (funded by the University of Maryland)
provider: Australian-American Fulbright Commission / University of Maryland
summary: This scholarship enables Australian students to complete a Master of Public Policy (MPP) or Master of Public Management (MPM) at the University of Maryland School of Public Policy. It provides financial support including a monthly stipend, tuition waiver, graduate assistantship, travel allowance, and settling-in allowance.
conditional_criteria: Must not have already commenced this degree in the U.S.; Must not have held a J1 or J2 visa in the 24 months before program commences.; Must include the University of Maryland in university preferences.; Must identify a master’s program at the University of Maryland School of Public Policy.; Must hold an undergraduate degree (applicants may be in their final year of study).

name: Next Generation of Scientists Awards
summary: The Next Generation of Scientists Awards provides crucial support to early-career researchers in Canada through a two-part program including a postdoctoral fellowship and an operating grant. It helps recipients establish their laboratories, build teams, and launch groundbreaking projects in cancer research.
conditional_criteria: Part 1: Must have completed at least 2 years of postdoctoral training at the time of accepting the fellowship.; Part 2: Must obtain a faculty position in a Canadian university or affiliated accredited research center.
documents_required: Commitment form from the University or Research Institute; Disclaimer and Indemnity; Full application

name: Montreal Council on Foreign Relations Economics Fellowship / Prix du CORIM - Affaires
summary: This fellowship provides $10,000 for a non-renewable internship of three or more months outside of Canada for master's students at McGill University. The research must focus on international economics.
documents_required: The application form duly completed, dated, and signed; Academic Curriculum vitae; A description of the research project with bibliography; All official University level transcripts; Two letters of recommendation

name: Tomlinson Doctoral Fellowships
summary: The Tomlinson Doctoral Fellowships are awarded annually by Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies (GPS) to recruit outstanding incoming students into doctoral degree programs at McGill University. The fellowship provides up to $35,000 per year for 3 years, with international students also receiving a Differential Fee Waiver.
conditional_criteria: Students whose latest degree was completed or in progress at McGill are ineligible, though former McGill students who later completed a graduate degree elsewhere may apply.; Visiting students at McGill, who are completing the requirements for a degree from another university, may apply.; Only applicants with a first class academic record (3.7 or 3.5 in Law in each of the last two years of full-time study).
documents_required: Application Form; Two letters of reference; Proposed supervisor's statement; All official transcripts or certified copies from university level studies; Admissions letter and funding letter

name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Scholarships
summary: The Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Scholarships provide up to $70,000 annually for up to three years to full-time doctoral students in the humanities and social sciences whose research addresses issues relevant to Canada's future. The award supports exceptional scholars who demonstrate leadership potential, academic excellence, and a commitment to creating meaningful impact beyond academia.
conditional_criteria: Canadian students must be currently registered or accepted in a doctoral program full-time in Canada or internationally.; International students must be currently registered or accepted in a doctoral program full-time in Canada.; Candidates must be in their 1st or 2nd year of a full-time doctoral program at the time of application.
documents_required: Transcripts from all postsecondary studies; Three reference letters (thesis supervisor, another academic referee, and a non-academic referee)

name: Schwarzman Scholarship
summary: This scholarship provides a year of study leading to a Master's degree in Global Affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing, China. The program fully funds students from around the world on an annual basis.
conditional_criteria: Applicants who hold passports from Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan or Macao apply by May 2025; applicants from all other countries apply by September 2025.
deadline_text: May 20, 2025 at 11:59PM China Standard Time for students from China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Macao; September 2025 for non-Chinese students
documents_required: A complete Schwarzman Scholars application, including required essays and short answer responses; A current résumé/CV; Official transcripts from all colleges; Three letters of recommendation

name: Adel S. Sedra Distinguished Graduate Award
summary: The Adel S. Sedra Distinguished Graduate Award recognizes doctoral students at the University of Toronto who demonstrate outstanding academic achievement and extracurricular leadership. Two fellowships of up to $15,000 are awarded annually, alongside $1,000 prizes for up to two finalists.
documents_required: Completed online application form; Curriculum vitae; Statement of no more than 500 words about future academic and career goals; Official transcripts

name: Funding opportunity: Focal awards: multilingual futures for UK growth and connectivity
summary: This funding opportunity provides AHRC doctoral focal awards to unlock linguistic and cultural expertise through consortium-model doctoral training grants. It supports up to 20 studentships per award over four cohorts to deliver world-class doctoral training and development in languages research.
conditional_criteria: Applications are by invitation only following a successful outline application.; Proposals must involve a minimum of one other HEI and a minimum of one partner beyond academia.

name: C. David Naylor University Fellowships
summary: The C. David Naylor University Fellowships support outstanding scholars commencing the first year of a full-time master's or doctoral program at the University of Toronto who have strong ties to Atlantic Canada. Two entrance fellowships are awarded each year, providing $30,000 for one year.
conditional_criteria: Must have strong ties to Atlantic Canada, independent of postsecondary studies; Must be a graduate of an Atlantic Canadian university (from Nova Scotia, Newfoundland & Labrador, New Brunswick or Prince Edward Island); Must be available to participate in an interview as a part of the selection process
documents_required: transcripts; scholarships; curriculum vitae; letters of recommendation; contribution to research and development

name: Next Gen Pregnancy Initiative
summary: The Next Generation Pregnancy Initiative supports innovative basic science research focused on healthy pregnancy mechanisms, preterm birth, pregnancy loss, and preeclampsia. Eligible applicants include senior postdoctoral fellows, staff scientists, Assistant Professors, and Associate Professors based at non-profit institutions in the U.S. or Canada.
conditional_criteria: Current or prior BWF Pre-term Birth Grant or Next Generation Pregnancy award recipients are ineligible to apply.; Candidates who currently hold any other Burroughs Wellcome Fund competitive award must contact BWF staff before applying.
documents_required: NIH-style biosketch; Signature Page Form; Institutional Certification Form; Tentative budget

name: CAGS/ProQuest- Distinguished Dissertation Awards & John Leyerle-CIFAR Prize for Interdisciplinary Research
provider: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto
summary: This award recognizes outstanding Canadian doctoral dissertations that make significant, original contributions to both the academic community and to Canadian society. It includes prizes for both broad disciplinary categories and interdisciplinary research.
conditional_criteria: For the John Leyerle-CIFAR Prize: Demonstrate work with strong emphasis on interdisciplinary approach to an original research topic.
documents_required: nomination letter; letter from the applicant's supervisor; copy of the external examiner's pre-defence report; abstract of the dissertation; statement summarizing the dissertation; up-to-date curriculum vitae (CV)

name: Canada Graduate Scholarships-Doctoral (CGS D) Program
summary: A doctoral scholarship program for domestic students at the University of Toronto, funded by the Tri-Agency (CIHR, NSERC, and SSHRC). It provides annual funding of $40,000 for a duration of up to 36 months.
conditional_criteria: Indigenous applicants; Black student researchers
documents_required: online application form; transcripts

name: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowship
provider: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (Funded entirely by JSPS, nominated by Royal Society)
summary: This fellowship provides early-career postdoctoral researchers in the UK the opportunity to conduct cooperative research in Japan with leading research groups in Japanese institutions. The scheme covers air travel, maintenance allowance, settling-in allowance, and insurance for a duration of 12 to 24 months.
conditional_criteria: Must have a research proposal agreed with a Japanese host scientist

name: Lung Cancer Translational Research Grant Competition
summary: This programme provides research grants for translational research on lung cancer in Canada. It supports projects aimed at improving early detection, developing treatments, and understanding resistance mechanisms.
documents_required: letter of intent; full application

name: Research grants
summary: This scheme provides seed corn funding for up to 12 months for independent researchers in the UK who are at an early stage in their career or returning from a career break. It enables them to purchase specialised equipment and consumables, gather preliminary data, and develop their research ideas.
conditional_criteria: Must be within the first five years of an independent research post, at the time of application; Must be a fully independent researcher with access to your own lab space and with the ability to recruit and be registered as the primary supervisor of PhD students and research assistants; Research must be within the Royal Society’s remit of natural sciences
documents_required: scientific abstract; lay summary; research proposal

name: 2026 China Studies Program Ph. D. Fellowship in China at Peking University
provider: Center for Language Education and Cooperation of the Chinese Ministry of Education
summary: The China Studies Program Ph.D. Fellowship in China supports outstanding master's degree holders who are pursuing doctoral degrees in research related to China at Peking University. The study period is generally 4 years.
conditional_criteria: Program taught in Chinese: Applicant's Chinese proficiency level should reach HSK Level 6 with a score above 210, including a minimum score of 65 in writing (or qualified HSK 7-9 level scores).; Program taught in English: Chinese proficiency level should reach HSK level 5 and meet specific English proficiency requirements.
documents_required: Undergraduate degree diplomas and degree authentication; Official transcript during undergraduate studies; Master's degree diplomas and degree authentication; Official transcript during the master's program; Personal statement; Personal Resume; Commitment for Application letter; Two letters of recommendation; Original HSK transcript; Abstracts of the master's thesis and other research achievements
judges: GPT-OSS-120B (OpenAI); Nemotron 3 Super (NVIDIA); GLM-5.3 Flash (Zhipu AI)

name: Large Grant full applications: November 2026 (invite only)
summary: This funding opportunity supports innovative, large-scale and complex environmental science projects that tackle big science questions. The full economic cost of projects can range between £1.12 million and £3.45 million, funded at 80% by NERC for invited applicants based at eligible UK research organisations.
conditional_criteria: Must have been invited following a successful outline application.; Project co-lead (international) can be based in a Norwegian institution under the Money Follows Cooperation agreement.
documents_required: Facility form (if requesting ship time or marine facilities)

name: APEX awards
summary: The APEX award scheme offers established independent researchers an opportunity to pursue genuine interdisciplinary and curiosity-driven research to benefit wider society. Applicants can apply for up to £200,000 to support their interdisciplinary projects.
documents_required: application form

name: Dorothy Hodgkin Fellowship
fields: biology_life_sciences; biomedical_sciences; chemistry; earth_climate_sciences; mathematics_statistics; physics_astronomy
summary: The Dorothy Hodgkin Fellowship offers an exciting first step for outstanding early career researchers to develop an independent research career based on excellent research ideas. It supports researchers who have a current and ongoing need for flexible support due to personal circumstances, such as being a primary carer or having a clinically diagnosed health condition.
conditional_criteria: Must demonstrate a current and ongoing need for flexible support due to personal circumstances, eg being a primary carer or having a clinically diagnosed health condition.

name: Innovation in Regulatory Science
summary: The Innovation in Regulatory Science Awards provides up to $500,000 over five years to academic investigators developing new methodologies or innovative approaches in regulatory science that will ultimately inform FDA and other regulatory decisions. The program especially encourages applications that seek to expedite the realization of equitable clinical outcomes.
conditional_criteria: Must hold a faculty appointment or adjunct faculty appointment at a non-profit institution in the U.S. or Canada.; Temporary U.S. residents must hold a valid U.S. visa (J-1, H1B, F-1 or O-1 visas).; Temporary Canadian residents must hold a valid Canadian visa (Study Permit, C-43, C44, C-10, or C-20 work permits/visas).
documents_required: Application

name: Royal Society Leverhulme Trust Senior Research Fellowship
summary: This scheme provides experienced senior and mid-career researchers with the opportunity to focus on full-time research for up to one year by relieving them of teaching, administration, and pastoral care duties. It is funded by the Leverhulme Trust and covers teaching replacement salary costs along with research expenses.
conditional_criteria: Preference will be given to candidates who show that relief from teaching and administration is particularly needed and timely.
documents_required: Research proposal (maximum of two pages); Letters of support from collaborators (optional, where collaboration is an essential part of the project)

name: Prostate Cancer Research Grants
summary: This programme provides research grants to support cutting-edge translational research in prostate cancer focused on improving early detection and developing more effective treatments. Each grant offers up to $500,000 over a 3-year period for eligible researchers at Canadian institutions.
documents_required: Letter of intent; Full application

name: Starting Grant
summary: The ERC Starting Grant supports talented early-career scientists with 0-10 years of experience since their PhD to independently lead a research team and project in Europe. Grants are awarded up to €1.5 million for a period of 5 years.
conditional_criteria: Eligibility can be extended for reasons such as maternity, paternity, or parental leave, illness, national service, clinical training, natural disasters, asylum, or for victims of gender-based violence or any other form of violence.
