documents_required: administrative forms; research proposal; supplementary documents

name: China Studies Program at Peking University Joint Research Ph.D. Fellowship (“Senior Visiting Student”)
provider: Center for Language Education and Cooperation of the Chinese Ministry of Education / Peking University
summary: The Joint Research Ph.D. Fellowship supports outstanding doctoral candidates enrolled in foreign universities to come to China to conduct research and write their doctoral dissertations for one semester or more, up to two academic years. It is implemented by the Center for Language Education and Cooperation of the Chinese Ministry of Education and hosted at Peking University.
conditional_criteria: Language proficiency of HSK Level 3 or above.
documents_required: Peking University Application Form for International Students; Application Form for China Studies Program Joint Research Ph.D. Fellowship; Proof of enrollment as a Ph.D. candidate; Official transcript during the doctoral period; Two original letters of recommendation; HSK transcript; Abstract of the master's thesis and other research achievements; Doctoral dissertation abstract; Research plan during the stay in China; Passport information page

name: Synergy Grant
summary: The ERC Synergy Grant supports groups of two to four Principal Investigators working together to tackle ambitious research problems that cannot be solved by a single researcher alone. It provides up to €10 million for a period of 6 years to cover research costs and project needs.
conditional_criteria: One Principal Investigator per Synergy Grant group at any one time can be hosted or engaged by an institution outside of the EU or associated countries.
documents_required: administrative forms; research proposal; host support letter; supplementary documents

name: Doctoral Networks
summary: Doctoral Networks implement doctoral programmes by partnerships of organisations from different sectors across Europe and beyond to train highly skilled doctoral candidates. The funding covers living allowances, mobility allowances, and research, training and networking activities for researchers without a doctoral degree.
conditional_criteria: Should spend at least 50% of their time outside academia, for Industrial Doctorates; Must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country of the recruiting organisation for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before their recruitment date

name: Funding
provider: Universidade Lusófona’s Research Center for Digital Human-Environment Interaction Lab
summary: This call funds one Ph.D. Research Fellowship within the Digital Human-Environment Interaction Lab (HEI-Lab) at Universidade Lusófona, supported by FCT. The successful candidate will receive a monthly stipend of €1,359.64 for a duration of 12 months, renewable up to 48 months.
conditional_criteria: The selected candidate should be enrolled in the 1st year of the PhD in Clinical Psychology and Health, Cognitive-Behavioural Orientation programme at Universidade Lusófona.; For academic degrees awarded by foreign higher education institutions, recognition of the degree and conversion of the final grade to the Portuguese grading scale must be obtained by the application deadline.
documents_required: Motivation letter; Master’s degree certificate; Names, identification details and contact information of at least two academic referees; Other documents considered relevant by the applicant; PhD thesis resume (one page)

name: Freedom Scholarship
provider: Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) Germany
summary: This scholarship supports non-EU students with liberal-minded and excellent grades pursuing master's studies in various disciplines at state or state-recognized universities in Germany. The award provides funding for one year, renewable yearly until graduation.
conditional_criteria: Candidates must still have two remaining semesters before completing studies.

name: Investigators in the Pathogenesis of Infectious Disease
summary: The Investigators in the Pathogenesis of Infectious Disease (PATH) program provides opportunities for assistant professors to bring multidisciplinary approaches to studying human infectious diseases. It provides $505,000 over five years to give recipients the freedom and flexibility to pursue new avenues of inquiry and stimulate higher-risk research projects.
documents_required: Institutional Letter of Support; Letters of Recommendation; Research Plan; Biographical sketch

name: Project Grant Program
summary: The Project Grant program supports research projects proposed and conducted by individual researchers or groups of researchers, at any career stage, in all areas of health. It is designed to capture ideas with the greatest potential to advance health-related fundamental or applied knowledge, health research, health care, health systems, and/or health outcomes.
conditional_criteria: global health or international collaborations; meaningful and culturally safe research involving Indigenous Peoples; randomized controlled trial (RCT); commercialization; interdisciplinary research; competition-specific Priority Announcements

name: Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program
summary: The Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program supports young Asian students studying away from their home region or country within Asia at CUHK. It aims to promote cross-cultural understanding and leadership with awards of up to US$25,000 per year for up to 2 years.
conditional_criteria: Registered full-time CUHK students during the Scholarship period; Non-local students whose nationality is from an Asian country or region

name: Nursing in Indigenous Research in Action (NIRA) Chairs Funding Opportunity
summary: This funding opportunity supports Indigenous-led, community-driven nursing research chairs across Canada that advance culturally safe health systems and strengthen research mentorship and leadership. The programme funds thirteen chairs (three renewals and ten new awards) for up to five years each.
conditional_criteria: For New Chair Awards, applicants must self-identify as First Nations, Inuit and/or Métis (Indigenous).

name: Apply for Horizon Europe guarantee funding
summary: The Horizon Europe guarantee scheme provides funding to UK-based researchers and innovators who were successful in applying for Horizon Europe grants under Work Programmes 2021, 2022, or 2023 but were unable to receive direct EU funding due to the UK's association timing. UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) delivers the funding through its grant systems on behalf of the government.
conditional_criteria: Must have been successful at applying for a Horizon Europe grant during the Work Programme 2021, 2022 or 2023; Must have been included on the initial grant proposal as a 'beneficiary' with an assigned budget
documents_required: conversion tool template; currency conversion template for IFS

name: The Scholarship
summary: Gates Cambridge offers full-cost scholarships to outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge. Approximately two-thirds of these awards will be offered to PhD students.
conditional_criteria: Where a student has been successful in gaining a fee award from public authorities they should accept this award and the Trust will not pay their fee or may share their fee and maintenance costs.; If you are receiving a salary from an employer or have another substantial scholarship, the Trust reserves the right to reduce or not pay the standard maintenance allowance.

name: Croucher Studentships for Doctoral Study – Studentships in Hong Kong
fields: biology_life_sciences; biomedical_sciences; chemistry; earth_climate_sciences; energy_sustainability; medicine_clinical; physics_astronomy
summary: The Croucher Studentships for Doctoral Study support full-time study or research in natural sciences, technology, and medicine leading to a PhD degree in approved academic institutions in Hong Kong. The award provides a cash award and an annual academic development allowance for up to 3 years.
conditional_criteria: Academic excellence

name: UKRI-funded studentships
summary: UKRI-funded studentships provide funding to UK universities and research organisations to cover the fees and living costs of postgraduate research students, primarily working towards a PhD. Applicants must apply directly through the specific research organisation where they want to study.
conditional_criteria: Research organisations have their own eligibility criteria which you will need to meet.; International students can usually apply, but the number of places available to international students is limited.
judges: Nemotron 3 Super (NVIDIA); GLM-5.3 Flash (Zhipu AI); Phi-4-mini (Microsoft)

name: Study scholarships for STEM disciplines
fields: mathematics_statistics; computer_science; chemical_materials_engineering; civil_environmental_engineering; electrical_engineering; mechanical_aerospace_engineering
summary: This scholarship supports young academics and future professionals from developing and emerging countries to pursue a full-time Master's degree in STEM fields at a state or state-recognised university in Germany. It provides monthly payments, insurance coverage, and allowances for study, travel, and language courses.
conditional_criteria: Must not already have a Master's degree by the application deadline.; Must not have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.; Must be a student from a developing or emerging country.; Must demonstrate proficiency in the language of instruction (German or English) of at least level B1.
documents_required: curriculum vitae; Letter of motivation; Letter of admission; Form 'Information about your preferred master programmes'; Current overview of grades/ transcript of records; All university degree certificates; Certificate of language(s) of instruction; Letter of recommendation; Passport/national identity card

name: Humboldt Research Fellowship
summary: The Humboldt Research Fellowship enables postdocs and experienced researchers of all nationalities and disciplines to conduct their own independent research in collaboration with a host at a German research institution. The fellowship provides a monthly stipend plus additional benefits such as family allowances, travel expenses, and health insurance subsidies.
conditional_criteria: German nationals may apply if they have lived and worked abroad for more than ten years.; Applicants may not have lived in Germany for longer than a total of 90 days within the 18-month period prior to submitting the application.; Postdocs must have completed their doctorate within the last four years.; Experienced researchers must have completed their doctorate within the last twelve years.
documents_required: curriculum vitae (two pages max); research outline ( five pages max); complete list of your publications; list of selected key publications; key publications; doctoral certificate or proof that your doctorate has been completed successfully; German language certificate, if required; two expert reviews; a detailed statement of your host in Germany as well as a confirmation of research facilities

name: Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
summary: This scholarship programme offers international students the opportunity to continue their academic education in Germany with a postgraduate or Master's degree course in all academic disciplines. Funded by the German Federal Foreign Office, it provides a monthly stipend of 992 euros, health insurance, and travel allowances for visits between 10 and 24 months.
conditional_criteria: Most recent university degree should not date back more than 6 years at the time of the application deadline.; Cannot be considered if resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.
documents_required: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages); Statement about academic and personal reasons for the planned study project in Germany (letter of motivation; 1 - 3 page; Letter of admission to the study programme at the host university in Germany; Form 'Information about your preferred master programmes' (if planning second degree or Master’s); Proof that credits acquired in Germany will be recognised by your home university (if planning part of degree abroad); Current overview of grades/ transcript of records; University degree certificate; Proof of knowledge of language(s) of instruction; One recent, supporting letter of recommendation from a university teacher

name: Research Grants in Germany
summary: This research grant offers international doctoral students and early-career postdocs the opportunity to realize a research project at a state or state-recognized university or non-university research institute in Germany. The funding provides monthly scholarship payments, insurance coverage, and travel allowances for periods ranging from 2 to 12 months for doctoral candidates and 2 to 6 months for postdocs.
conditional_criteria: Doctoral students: The start of your doctorate should not be more than 3 years ago at the application deadline.; Postdocs: You should not have completed your doctorate more than 4 years before the application deadline.; You cannot apply if you are doing your entire doctorate at a German university.
documents_required: curriculum vitae; list of your published publications; letter of motivation; proposal; time schedule; proof of admission to doctoral studies/enrolment for doctoral studies; confirmation from the academic host in Germany; Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany; all university degree certificates you have already obtained; Transcripts of Records

name: In-Country/In-Region Programme
summary: The In-Country/In-Region scholarship programme supports postgraduate studies and doctorates for future professionals and managerial staff in developing countries, in particular university teachers. Scholarships are awarded for study at universities in the recipient's home country or in their home region.
conditional_criteria: Travel allowance and health insurance are generally only provided for In-Region Scholarship holders.

name: Studienstipendien - Masterstudium für MINT-Fächer
fields: mathematics_statistics; computer_science; physics_astronomy; chemistry; biology_life_sciences; electrical_engineering; mechanical_aerospace_engineering; civil_environmental_engineering; chemical_materials_engineering
summary: This scholarship programme aims to support the qualification and employability of young academics and professionals from developing and emerging countries by funding a complete, tuition-free Master's degree in STEM fields at a state or state-recognized higher education institution in Germany. The funding period ranges from 10 to a maximum of 24 months depending on the standard period of study.
conditional_criteria: Master degrees with tuition fees are excluded.; Must not already hold a Master's degree.; Must not have been in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.; Last relevant higher education degree should generally not date back more than 6 years.
documents_required: Lebenslauf; Motivationsschreiben; Zulassung; DAAD-Formular Studiengangsprofil; Aktueller Notenspiegel/Transcript of Records; Alle bereits erworbenen Hochschulabschlusszeugnisse; Sprachnachweis; Empfehlungsschreiben; Reisepass/Nationaler Personalausweis

name: Capacity building: clinical research training fellowship
summary: This fellowship funds registered healthcare professionals who are PhD graduates working outside of research to reacquire research skills and pursue a clinical academic career. It covers salary, project costs, travel, and training activities for typically three years.
conditional_criteria: Must be a registered healthcare professional; Must be working outside of research, usually five or more years since PhD; Must be at an appropriate point in clinical training; Must be based at an eligible UK research organisation

name: DFG Funding of Science Communication
summary: This programme provides funding for science communication activities linked to existing DFG-funded research projects. It supports researchers in presenting their research questions, working methods, and findings to the general public in a transparent and accessible manner.
conditional_criteria: Must be linked to a DFG-funded research project.
documents_required: Description of the activities and identification of the target groups; Module Science Communication Guidelines (DFG form 52.07)

name: CAPES-Humboldt Research Fellowship
provider: Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and CAPES
summary: The CAPES-Humboldt Research Fellowship supports postdoctoral and experienced researchers from Brazil to conduct their own research in collaboration with a host at a German research institution. Fellowships provide monthly stipends ranging from €3,000 to €3,600 plus additional benefits and last from 6 to 24 months.
conditional_criteria: Postdoc applicants must have completed their doctorate within the last four years.; Experienced researchers must have completed their doctorate within the last twelve years and hold a leadership role.; German nationals must have lived and working in Brazil for at least five years.; Natural sciences and engineering applicants must have a good knowledge of German or English.; Humanities, social sciences and medicine applicants must have a good knowledge of German if necessary for research, otherwise good knowledge of English suffices.
documents_required: curriculum vitae (two pages max); research outline (five pages max); complete list of your publications; list of selected key publications; key publications; doctoral certificate; German language certificate, if required; detailed statement of your host in Germany as well as a confirmation of research facilities

name: Feodor Lynen Research Fellowship
summary: The Feodor Lynen Research Fellowship enables researchers from Germany at all career levels and in all disciplines to conduct research abroad with members of the Humboldt Network. Postdocs may receive funding for 6 to 24 months, and experienced researchers for 6 to 18 months.
conditional_criteria: Postdocs may apply for a 6- to 24-month fellowship.; Experienced researchers may apply for a 6- to 18-month fellowship that can be split into up to three stays over the course of three years.; Postdocs must have completed their doctorate during the last four years or be within six months of completion.; Experienced researchers must have completed their doctorate during the last twelve years.; Must not have spent more than 6 months in total in the selected host country within the 18-month period prior to submitting the application.
documents_required: curriculum vitae (two pages max); research outline (five pages max); complete list of your publications; list of selected key publications; key publications; doctoral certificate or proof that your doctorate has been completed successfully; Host's statement and confirmation that research facilities are available; two expert reviews

name: Max Planck Postdoc Program
summary: The Max Planck Postdoc Program provides talented early career researchers with bundled postdoctoral positions and career development opportunities across various subject areas. Successful candidates receive a guaranteed contract duration of at least three years, alongside targeted mentoring and career workshops.
conditional_criteria: Depending on the requirements of the respective postdoctoral position, applicants must provide the e-mail addresses of 2-3 references who can provide a letter of recommendation.
documents_required: cover letter; CV with a list of publications; summary of previous research experience; statement explaining interest in the position

name: Max Planck-Weizmann Postdoctoral Programme
provider: Max Planck Society and Weizmann Institute of Science
summary: The Max Planck-Weizmann Postdoctoral Programme offers outstanding postdoctoral researchers a prestigious four-year appointment divided between the Max Planck Society in Germany and the Weizmann Institute of Science in Israel. It supports innovative, interdisciplinary research in the life sciences, natural sciences, and social and human sciences.
conditional_criteria: Must contact researchers at the MPG and WIS and establish an active project with joint hosts.; Letters of support from MPG and WIS guest scientists including assurance of co-financing.
documents_required: Detailed CV; At least three letters of recommendation; Letters of support from the MPG and WIS guest scientists; Project outline (limited to two pages); Statement of the planned division between the institutes

name: Fraunhofer-Bessel Research Award
provider: Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and the Fraunhofer Gesellschaft
summary: The Fraunhofer-Bessel Research Award honours internationally recognised academics working in applied research abroad for their outstanding scientific achievements. The award provides €45,000 and enables a research stay of six months to a full year at a research institution in Germany in cooperation with specialist colleagues.
conditional_criteria: Exceptions to the PhD time limit may be made for well-founded cases such as career breaks to raise children.; Nominee may not previously have received an award from the Humboldt Foundation for her/his academic work.; Nominee must not yet have entered permanent employment in Germany at the time of selection.
documents_required: nomination form; laudation; CV; list of academic publications

name: Georg Forster Research Fellowship
summary: The Georg Forster Research Fellowship enables researchers from developing and emerging countries to conduct their own research in collaboration with a host at a German research institution. The research must address questions relevant to the sustainable development of the applicant's region of origin.
conditional_criteria: Must be a citizen of a developing or transition country (excluding PR China and India).; Must have lived and worked in a developing or transition country for at least 12 months within the last 18 months.; Research must address questions relevant to the sustainable development of the region of origin.; Postdocs must have completed a doctorate within the last four years or within six months of application.; Experienced researchers must have completed a doctorate within the last twelve years.
documents_required: curriculum vitae; research outline; complete list of your publications; list of key publications; key publications; doctoral certificate or proof that your doctorate has been completed successfully; German language certificate, if required; host's statement and confirmation that research facilities are available

name: Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel Research Award
summary: The Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel Research Award provides €60,000 to internationally renowned academics from abroad to conduct a research project of their choice in Germany in cooperation with specialist colleagues. The award enables a total stay of between six months and a full year, which can be split into multiple stays.
conditional_criteria: Exceptions to the 18-year limit for doctorates may be made where justified (e.g., career breaks to raise children, military/alternative service, care for close relatives, long-term illness, or epidemic-related lockdowns).; Nominees who hold German citizenship must have been working abroad in an academic position for at least five years.; Nominees who do not hold a doctorate may be considered if a doctorate is not customary or possible in their country of origin or discipline, provided their academic performance is equivalent to a Ph.D.
documents_required: nomination form; laudation; list of key publications; complete list of publications covering the past 10 years

name: Studienstipendien - Masterstudium für alle wissenschaftlichen Fächer
summary: This scholarship programme offers international students the opportunity to continue their academic training in Germany with a postgraduate or Master's degree programme at a state or state-recognized higher education institution in Germany, or an academic year as part of a Master's programme at their home university. It provides a monthly stipend of 992 euros, travel allowances, insurance, and study support for a duration of between 10 and 24 months.
conditional_criteria: Nicht bewerben können Sie sich, wenn Sie sich zum Bewerbungsschluss bereits länger als 15 Monate in Deutschland aufhalten.; Für künstlerische Fachbereiche sowie den Fachbereich Architektur bietet der DAAD andere Studienstipendienprogramme an.
documents_required: Lückenloser tabellarischer Lebenslauf; Motivationsschreiben; Zulassung zum Studiengang an der Gasthochschule in Deutschland; Formular „Informationen über Ihre gewünschten Masterstudiengänge“ oder Anerkennungsnachweis; Aktueller Notenspiegel/Transcript of Records; Abschlusszeugnis der Hochschule; Sprachnachweis der Kenntnisse der Unterrichtssprache(n); Empfehlungsschreiben einer Hochschullehrkraft

name: First Research Article Fellowship Program
provider: Max Planck Institute for the History of Science
summary: The First Research Article Fellowship Program offers six-month fellowships at the Max Planck Institute for the History of Science in Berlin for outstanding doctoral students from Asian, African, or Latin American institutions. It provides support to prepare and publish their first single-authored research paper in English.
documents_required: Cover letter explaining how the applicant's proposed research fits the research themes of one specific department; Official enrollment certificate and confirmation that the applicant will remain enrolled in an accredited graduate progr; 500-word description of the dissertation written by the applicant; Curriculum vitae; Title, abstract, and outline of article to be completed during the fellowship; English-language writing sample; A letter of recommendation from one supervisor

name: Hilde Domin-Programm
summary: The Hilde Domin Programme supports worldwide endangered students and doctoral candidates who are denied the right to education in their home country, enabling them to pursue a study or doctoral degree at a German higher education institution. It covers necessary study and research stay costs including a monthly stipend, insurance, and travel cost allowances.
conditional_criteria: Exclusion of specific disciplines: Humanmedizin, Zahnmedizin, Veterinärmedizin, Pharmazie und Jura; Exclusion of certain countries: EU / EWR / EFTA-Länder sowie Andorra, Monaco, San Marino und Vereinigtes Königreich; Art, design, and architecture nominations require accreditation and confirmation from an arts university
documents_required: online Nominierungsformular; Fragebogen zur Gefährdungssituation

name: NL Scholarship
provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science as well as several Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences
summary: The NL Scholarship is meant for international students from outside the European Economic Area (EEA) who want to do their bachelor's or master's in the Netherlands. The scholarship amounts to € 5,000, which is received in the first year of studies.
conditional_criteria: You meet the specific requirements of the institution of your choice.

name: Surplace-/Drittlandstipendienprogramm
summary: Das Surplace-/Drittlandstipendienprogramm fördert die Ausbildung von Fach- und Führungskräften in Entwicklungsländern, insbesondere zukünftige Hochschullehrer. Es unterstützt Postgraduierten-Studiengänge bis hin zur Promotion an Hochschulen im Heimatland oder in der Region.
conditional_criteria: Reisekostenpauschalen und Krankenversicherungsbeiträge nur für Geförderte aus Drittländern.
documents_required: Bewerbungsformular

name: Communicator Award
summary: The Communicator Award recognizes outstanding achievements in science communication by individual researchers or teams. It is awarded to those who make their research findings and working methods accessible to a wider audience in creative and effective ways.
conditional_criteria: pursue their communication activities primarily in German-speaking countries
documents_required: informative description of achievements; curriculum vitae

name: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS) Research Fellowship
provider: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
summary: A research fellowship for highly qualified postdocs from Germany to conduct research in Japan across any discipline. It offers short-term (1-12 months) and standard (12-24 months) funding lines.
conditional_criteria: Humanities scholars, social and medical scientists must however have good knowledge of Japanese if needed to successfully carry out their research.
documents_required: curriculum vitae; description of your research project; complete list of your publications; list of selected key publications; key publications; doctoral certificate; confirmation that research facilities are available/host’s statement; mentoring agreement; two expert reviews

name: Hezekiah Wardwell Fellowship
summary: The Hezekiah Wardwell Fellowship enables gifted young musicians or musicologists from Spain to attend further training or an advanced degree programme at an academy of music or a conservatory in Germany. It provides funding for one or two semesters of study, along with a monthly stipend and travel allowances.
documents_required: links to video recordings; thesis, publications; curriculum vitae; your expectations and objectives for the period of the fellowship; statement of your prospective study supervisor in Germany; expert reviews

name: Research Fellowships
summary: Funding for early career researchers to conduct a defined research project at a location of their choice outside of Germany. The programme allows researchers to familiarise themselves with new research methods or bring a large project to a conclusion.
conditional_criteria: International researchers must have been resident in Germany for several years; International researchers must have completed at least three years of scientific work as a doctoral or postdoctoral researcher in the German research system; International researchers must state that they wish to continue to pursue their research in Germany in the future; Established researchers holding a doctorate may submit proposals for research projects of particular importance

name: Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme
summary: The Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme supports qualified applicants to pursue a postdoctoral fellowship at an eligible research body in Ireland for one or two years. It provides funding for research across all disciplines.
documents_required: application form; mentor form

name: SI Baltic Sea and Eastern Partnership Programme
summary: Funding for projects aimed at enhanced capacity, competence, and network-building between Swedish actors and partners in the Baltic Sea region and the EU's Eastern Partnership. It provides grants for seed funding, cooperation projects, and training programmes.
conditional_criteria: Eastern Partnership strand: cooperation between a Swedish actor and actors in Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Poland; Baltic Sea region strand: cooperation between Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, Poland, Sweden, Germany, Moldova and Ukraine; Azerbaijan, Belarus and/or Georgia: may not include actors that are part of, controlled by, or financed by the state; Azerbaijan and Ukraine may only participate in multilateral cooperation; Baltic Sea region strand: Only multilateral projects are possible
documents_required: Budget; Memorandum of Understanding (MoU); Activity plan; Partner Letter; Programme Draft; Organisation Description; Company Enclosure; Bank Account Details

name: SI Ukraine Cooperation Programme
summary: Funds cooperation projects between Swedish and Ukrainian actors to strengthen organisational capacity and competence. The programme focuses on innovation ecosystems, transparency, anti-corruption, and gender equality to support Ukraine's EU integration.
conditional_criteria: At least one legal entity in Ukraine must be part of the formal partnership; Partnerships may include up to two partners from selected EU countries if they add value; Business companies may only participate as main applicants or partners on a non-profit basis; Political parties and their youth affiliates cannot be main applicants but may participate as project partners

name: FWF Wittgenstein Award
summary: The FWF Wittgenstein Award provides a €2 million endowment to outstanding researchers from all disciplines to advance their research work. It is aimed at researchers with a high international reputation and permanent employment at an Austrian research institution.

name: FWF ASTRA Awards
summary: The FWF ASTRA Awards provide funding for advanced postdocs in Austria to conduct long-term research projects and prepare for academic leadership positions. It supports internationally visible researchers across all disciplines, including arts-based research.
conditional_criteria: Doctoral degree awarded 2-9 years prior to September 30 of the submission year; Arts-based research: 2-9 years of relevant experience instead of a doctoral degree; Maximum of two applications throughout career; Women PIs: additional €200,000 tenure package for permanent positions
documents_required: Application Guidelines; Template publication record; Template Data Management Plan; Checklist ASTRA Awards; Form for accounting for career interruptions

name: Postdoctoral Fellowships
summary: The Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Postdoctoral Fellowships fund researchers holding a PhD to carry out research activities abroad, acquire new skills, and develop their careers. The programme covers all areas of research, including STEM, social sciences, humanities, economic sciences, and Euratom research.
conditional_criteria: European Fellowships mobility rule: must not have resided or carried out main activity in the beneficiary country for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the call deadline.; Global Fellowships mobility rule: must not have resided or carried out main activity in the host organisation country for the outgoing phase for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the call deadline.; Global Fellowships nationality: only nationals or long-term residents of EU Member States or Horizon Europe Associated Countries can apply.
documents_required: application documentation

name: Gottfried and Vera Weiss Award
provider: Dr. Gottfried and Dr. Vera Weiss Science Foundation, Austrian Science Fund (FWF)
summary: The Gottfried and Vera Weiss Award supports excellent researchers carrying out basic research projects in meteorology and related disciplines such as climate research, atmospheric research, and environmental research. Applications can be submitted under FWF programs including Principal Investigator Projects, ESPRIT, and Erwin Schrödinger.
conditional_criteria: Must apply under FWF programs: Principal Investigator Projects, ESPRIT, or Erwin Schrödinger.
documents_required: Supplementary Application Guidelines Gottfried and Vera Weiss Award; Application documents Principal Investigator Projects, Erwin Schrödinger, or ESPRIT; Additional form on elane detailing relevance to the topic

name: CEITEC Postdoctoral EXperts (CEIPEX)
summary: The CEITEC Postdoctoral EXperts (CEIPEX) program offers postdoctoral researchers up to 32 months of research training and career development in the South Moravian Region of the Czech Republic. It supports international networking, interdisciplinary and intersectoral mobility, and full employment with social and health security.
conditional_criteria: Adjusted given family status (dependent spouse and/or number of children).
documents_required: CEIPEX 2026.pdf

name: ATLAS - Talent Academy for TransLAtional Science
summary: The ATLAS Talent Academy for Translational Science offers a joint doctoral program by BioNTech and TRON for international graduate training in translational medicine. The program provides fully financed PhD positions and training with no tuition fees, with projects typically completed within 4-5 years.

name: Ragnar Söderberg post doc grants in law
summary: This programme provides prominent early-career researchers in law with substantial funding to advance their academic careers and support new research findings. The grant covers 80% of a two-year full-time university salary, direct project costs, and international travel.
conditional_criteria: Must be employed at a Swedish higher education institute for the duration of the grant period, with 80% of the time devoted to research and 20% to teaching.; If not yet established in Sweden, must be employed at a Swedish university by the start of the grant period and the application must be signed by the institution's Head of Department.

name: Long-Term Mobility Grants for PhD Students and Early Career Researchers
provider: Stiftelsen för internationalisering av högre utbildning och forskning (STINT)
summary: This programme supports PhD students and early career researchers at Swedish SASUF partner universities to spend a five-month research period at a SASUF partner university in South Africa. The grant covers a monthly maintenance allowance, housing, and travel expenses.
conditional_criteria: Must be currently enrolled as a doctoral student or obtained a doctoral degree in 2022 or later at a Swedish SASUF partner university.; Must remain employed by or enrolled at the home university at the time of application and throughout the entire mobility period.

name: Funding opportunity: What Works Centre for a climate resilient UK
fields: earth_climate_sciences; agriculture_food; energy_sustainability; economics; business_management; social_sciences
summary: This funding opportunity provides a grant of up to £21.1 million to establish and lead a What Works Centre for a climate resilient UK. It supports researchers based at UK research organisations eligible for ESRC funding to generate, synthesise, and mobilise evidence on climate adaptation interventions.
conditional_criteria: Project lead must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) funding.; Project leads from UK-based businesses, third sector, government bodies, or non-UK organisations are not eligible.; Application must include at least one project co-lead from business, the third sector, or government bodies based in the UK.

name: 5th call for research applications under Activity 1.1.1.9 “Post-doctoral Research”
summary: This programme provides post-doctoral research funding to develop the skills of new scientists and increase scientific capacity in Latvia. It supports both fundamental and industrial research applications implemented at scientific institutions or enterprises in Latvia.
conditional_criteria: Mobility allowance of EUR 710 per month requires a mobility duration of at least six months.; Family allowance of EUR 660 per month requires a mobility duration of at least six months and fulfillment of eligibility conditions.; Research applications not related to economic activity must be submitted by a registered Latvian scientific institution or qualifying higher education institution.; Research applications related to economic activity must be submitted by a registered Latvian enterprise or a scientific institution that does not meet the definition of a research and knowledge-dissemination organisation.
documents_required: Initial Research Application; Full Research Application

name: Maynooth University Department of Chemistry PhD Scholarship
summary: This PhD scholarship funds a four-year full-time PhD position in the Department of Chemistry at Maynooth University focusing on coarse-grained and mesoscale modelling of polymer-hybrid anion-exchange membranes. The award provides a student stipend of €25,000 per annum, annual tuition fees support, and a contribution to research and travel costs for suitably qualified applicants.
documents_required: A personal statement; A curriculum vitae (CV); A short research proposal; Final academic transcripts; Contact details of two referees

name: Maynooth University Doctoral Scholarship - Department of Computer Science
summary: Maynooth University offers a fully funded four-year doctoral scholarship in the Department of Computer Science for a student pursuing PhD research on Music Information Retrieval for Irish Traditional Music. The award covers an annual student stipend of €25,000 and tuition fees support for a full-time candidate commencing in February 2027.
deadline_text: 5 pm on Monday 19th October 2026, Dublin time
documents_required: Personal statement (max. 400 words); Curriculum Vitae; Research proposal (max. 2,500 words); Academic transcripts; Names and contact details of two referees

name: Georg Arnhold Senior Fellow for Education for Sustainable Peace
provider: Leibniz Institute for Educational Media | Georg Eckert Institute (GEI)
summary: This fellowship offers outstanding and experienced scholars or practitioners in peace education the opportunity to complete a six-month research stay at the Georg Eckert Institute in Germany. The fellowship is endowed with a monthly stipend of 3,300 EUR and focuses on educational media and curricula supporting sustainable peace.
conditional_criteria: Practitioner applicants are required to demonstrate at least five years of advanced professional achievement in their field.

name: Funding opportunity: Long-term cultural and sporting events legacy
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants to research the long-term impact and legacy of major sporting and cultural events in the UK, focusing on running live experimental evaluations. It is open to UK research organisations eligible for AHRC funding and standard UKRI eligibility.
conditional_criteria: Project lead and any project co-leads must be employed and supported by an eligible organisation for at least the duration of the UKRI support.; During your project, you must be primarily based and permitted to work in the UK.; Government departments and arm’s length bodies are not eligible to apply for this funding.

name: AHRC Standard research grant: applicant-led mode
summary: This funding opportunity supports well-defined collaborative projects across the arts and humanities within the AHRC remit. The full economic cost (FEC) of projects can range between £300,000 and £1,500,000, with AHRC funding 80% of the FEC.
conditional_criteria: Applications must include a project lead and at least one project co-lead.; Project studentships (funding PhD study) are not supported.

name: AHRC Curiosity Award: applicant-led mode
summary: This award funds fundamental, early-stage, and novel research in the arts and humanities, leading to new research agendas, networking activity, and idea generation. It provides up to £100,000 in full economic cost for projects lasting up to five years, and is open to individuals based at eligible UK research organisations without requiring an academic, research, or teaching post.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can apply as project co-lead (international).

name: Freedom Scholarship for doctoral students from EU countries
provider: Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF), Germany
summary: This scholarship supports doctoral students from EU countries pursuing their PhD in various disciplines at state or state-recognized universities in Germany. It provides a monthly stipend, travel support, and grants for stays abroad, research, and conferences for one year, with possible extensions up to two additional years.
conditional_criteria: Doctorates in human medicine and dentistry, and doctorates during the final phase can not be funded.; Candidates with a law degree can only apply for a doctoral scholarship if they have already completed their postgraduate traineeship (law, teaching, medicine) or will only start it after their doctorate.; Knowledge of German at the minimum level of B2 is essential for participating in ideational support.
documents_required: Application documents

name: Summer Institute for the Study of East Central and Southeastern Europe (SISECSE)
summary: The Summer Institute for the Study of East Central and Southeastern Europe provides a two-week residential workshop in Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria, giving scholars dedicated time and space for research, writing, and optional local fieldwork. It is open to postdoctoral and advanced researchers in the humanities or interpretive social sciences focused on East Central and Southeastern Europe. The program covers travel, accommodation, and per diem expenses for the full residency.
conditional_criteria: Applicants must hold an institutional affiliation in North America (Canada, Mexico, or the United States) or in the eligible countries of East Central and Southeastern Europe.

name: AHRC Catalyst Awards: applicant-led mode
summary: The AHRC Catalyst Awards provide grants ranging from £100,000 to £300,000 to support researchers without prior experience of leading a significant research project to accelerate their trajectory as independent researchers. The scheme is open to researchers based at UK research organisations eligible for AHRC funding, and applicants do not need to hold an academic, research, or teaching post.
conditional_criteria: Cannot be a current or former project lead on AHRC or other UKRI research grants or fellowship grants at point of application, with specific stated exceptions.; Project co-lead (international) costs can be funded at 100% FEC up to 30% of the total FEC of the project, subject to specific conditions.

name: Centres of Excellence for Regulatory Science and Innovation
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants to establish Centres of Excellence for Regulatory Science and Innovation (CERSIs) to address strategic regulatory science priorities through sustained programmes of research. It is open to eligible UK research organisations to fund multidisciplinary teams led by a nominated centre director.
conditional_criteria: Project leads cannot be based at an international research organisation, including MRC Unit The Gambia at LSHTM or MRC/UVRI and LSHTM Uganda Research Unit.; Businesses, charity and third sector organisations cannot apply as project lead or project co-lead, but can participate as project partners (unless approved UKRI independent research organisations).; International researchers can apply as 'project co-lead (international)'.

name: ATTRACT
summary: The ATTRACT programme from the Fonds National de la Recherche (FNR) offers five-year fellowships to outstanding junior researchers to establish independent research teams at Luxembourg institutions in National Research Priorities. It provides funding tracks for Starting Investigators and Consolidating Investigators.
conditional_criteria: Extendable for eligible career breaks, up to a maximum of 11 years for years since PhD.; Must not yet be established in Luxembourg.; Must not have been employed by the host institution for more than a year at full proposal submission.; Proposed research must align with one of Luxembourg's four National Research Priorities.

name: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships
summary: The Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships enable internationally renowned scholars to carry out research of their own interest within a stimulating intellectual environment in Portugal. The fellowship supports stays of 3 to 8 months in any scientific domain that does not have laboratory, experimental, practical, or applied requirements.
conditional_criteria: Proposed work must not have laboratory or experimental requirements and must not be predominantly practical or applied in nature.

name: Gambling harms research grants
summary: This funding opportunity supports research projects that deepen understanding or provide solutions for the prevention and treatment of gambling-related harms. It provides grants of up to £2 million per project (at 80% full economic cost) for a duration of three years.
conditional_criteria: Doctoral students are not eligible for this funding opportunity, and funds are not available for PhD studentships.
documents_required: letters of support from relevant data controllers or data services

name: Commercialising Knowledge Assets Fund (CKAF) Winter
summary: This fund provides grants ranging from £50,000 to £250,000 to UK registered government research organisations and public sector bodies. It aims to move viable public sector knowledge assets towards commercial readiness.
conditional_criteria: Must be a Public Sector Research Establishment (PRSE), UKRI wholly owned institute, or other public sector bodies that meet GOTT standard eligibility criteria, for example, arms length bodies (ALBs), that undertake research as a primary function

name: UKRI Enabling AI adoption across science and engineering
fields: data_science_ai; biology_life_sciences; chemical_materials_engineering; physics_astronomy; medicine_clinical; energy_sustainability
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants for ambitious and exploratory projects that bring together artificial intelligence and domain expertise to address research challenges in priority science and engineering disciplines. Projects must be no more than one year in duration with a maximum full economic cost of £250,000, funded at 80% by UKRI.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can only apply as 'project co-lead (international)' under specific cooperation agreements such as the UKRI-RCN Money Follows Cooperation agreement or the UKRI-IIASA agreement.
documents_required: Vision and Approach document

name: Attendance and engagement at UK sporting, cultural and heritage sites
fields: computer_science; data_science_ai; economics; business_management; social_sciences; humanities_arts; any
summary: This funding opportunity supports the development of novel data-intensive approaches for capturing engagement data from unticketed cultural, heritage, and sporting events, activities, and locations. The grant funds interdisciplinary research teams based at UK research organisations eligible for AHRC funding.
conditional_criteria: Government departments and arm’s length bodies are not eligible to apply for this funding.; Project studentships (funding PhD study) are not supported.

name: Rhodes Scholarships for the United States
summary: The Rhodes Scholarship is a fully funded, full-time postgraduate award enabling talented young people to study at the University of Oxford. Specifically, the Rhodes Scholarships for the United States offers 32 scholarships each year to citizens or permanent residents of the United States.
conditional_criteria: Must meet the age criteria for the scholarship

name: NQS Mission 2 Coordination Network
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This funding opportunity supports the establishment of a coordination network for Mission 2 of the UK National Quantum Strategy, bringing together researchers, industry partners, and network operators. It covers full economic costs up to £630,937 for projects lasting no more than 33 months.
conditional_criteria: May be named as project lead in no more than one application; Applications submitted to this funding opportunity cannot include a Norway-based project co-lead (international)

name: Focal award: EPSRC and MHCLG Fire Engineering Skills Hub
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This funding opportunity provides £5.9 million to establish a skills hub that delivers cohort-based doctoral training and develops postgraduate-level taught programmes and continuing professional development in fire engineering. It is open to higher education institutions forming multi-organisational consortia to strengthen the capacity and capability of the fire engineering profession.
conditional_criteria: The degree must be accredited by the Engineering Council or an equivalent body.
documents_required: expression of interest

name: NMIP sandpit: Digital materials for accelerated innovation
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This funding opportunity invites eligible researchers to attend a residential sandpit to develop high-impact collaborative projects integrating digital approaches to accelerate materials research. Following the sandpit, successful project proposals are invited to submit full applications for project funding.
conditional_criteria: Businesses are not eligible to apply for funding through this opportunity, though industry participants are welcome to attend as partners.; Must be able to attend the in-person sandpit for up to five days.
documents_required: Expression of interest (EOI) survey

name: Bioinformatics and Biological Resources Fund (26BBR)
provider: Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC)
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants to implement, improve, or consolidate bioinformatics or biological resources in support of UK bioscience. It is aimed at researchers and research technical professionals based at UK research organisations eligible for BBSRC funding.
conditional_criteria: International researchers are not eligible to apply for funding as part of this funding opportunity, but they can be included as project partners if relevant.

name: Funding opportunity: Expression of interest: Chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear (CBRN) medical countermeasures R&D
summary: This funding opportunity supports the development and testing of novel therapeutics, medical devices, diagnostics, and other interventions for CBRN threats. It is open to researchers at UK-based eligible research organisations to improve domestic preparedness.
conditional_criteria: Businesses, charities and third sector organisations cannot apply as project lead or project co-lead but can participate as project partners.; Charities and third sector organisations that are approved UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) independent research organisations are eligible to apply as project lead or project co-lead.; International research or commercial organisations cannot apply as a project lead, co-lead or project partner.
documents_required: expression of interest (EOI); full application

name: Fulbright Scholar Program
summary: The Fulbright Scholar Program supports Swedish researchers with a PhD who wish to research and/or lecture in the USA. It provides 50,000 SEK in funding plus support for travel, visa costs, insurance, and additional benefits for stays of 3 to 12 months.
conditional_criteria: Must have an established affiliation with an American university or research center

name: Guest Speaker Grants
summary: The Guest Speaker Grants from Wenner-Gren Stiftelserna support Swedish researchers or institutions to invite foreign guest lecturers with doctorates to come to Sweden. Applications can be made on a rolling basis, no later than 2 months before the date of the guest lecture.

name: Postdoctoral Scholarship Program in Mathematics for researchers from outside Sweden
summary: The Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation together with the Royal Swedish Academy of Science supports senior researchers at Swedish Universities to apply for financing of a post-doc position for researchers from outside Sweden. The fellowship provides funding support for up to 2 years to cover salary, travel, and living expenses.

name: ESRC applicant-led: grow awards
summary: Grow awards support individuals at key career points to develop new capabilities or pivot in a new direction, strengthening the long-term capacity and resilience of the UK social science research base. The grants fund projects lasting between 18 months and five years with full economic costs between £100,000 and £500,000.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can apply as project co-lead (international).; Business, third sector or government body project co-leads based in the UK can be included as a project co-lead.

name: Einstein Postdoctoral Grant
summary: The Einstein Postdoctoral Grant enables eligible Berlin institutions to recruit and retain outstanding researchers to focus on their research projects. The funding covers the candidate’s position as well as additional staff, directly incurred expenses and/or minor investments.
conditional_criteria: If the applicant in question has children, the application period shall be extended by two years per child, regardless of the applicant’s gender.; Exceptions due to care work, illness, or personal circumstances will be judged on a case-by-case basis.
deadline_text: Round 2: University internal deadlines close on October 5, 2026, and full applications are due on November 16, 2026.

name: ESRC applicant-led: challenge awards
summary: The ESRC challenge awards fund ambitious, larger-scale programmes that tackle major research, economic, and societal challenges. Projects must have full economic costs between £2 million and £10 million, with ESRC funding 80% of the cost for up to five years.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can apply as project co-lead (international).; Business, third sector or government body project co-leads based in the UK can also be included.
documents_required: remit query form

name: Funding opportunity: Pre-announcement: ESRC applicant-led: explore awards
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants for ambitious, curiosity-driven social science research within ESRC's remit. It supports individuals or small research teams of up to four core members based at eligible UK research organisations.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can apply as project co-lead (international) and must be included within the maximum team size.; Business, third sector or government body project co-leads based in the UK can also be included as a project co-lead.
documents_required: Summary; Vision; Approach; Applicant and team capability to deliver; Ethics and responsible research and innovation (RRI)

name: EPSRC-Defra Reimagining Circularity: full stage
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This funding opportunity invites eligible UK research organisations to develop a NetworkPlus focused on the circular economy in data and metrics, or textiles. The grant covers 80% of the full economic cost (FEC) for up to 36 months, supporting interdisciplinary research and collaboration.
conditional_criteria: Must have been invited to apply following a successful outline application.; Must be within majority EPSRC remit.; Holders of postdoctoral level fellowships are not eligible to apply for an EPSRC grant.

name: CoSTAR Satellite Labs: Accessible creative R&D infrastructure
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants to establish up to two Satellite Labs as part of the CoSTAR programme, supporting accessible creative R&D infrastructure for the creative sector. The funding covers equipment, technology, staff, utilities, and access programmes to reduce barriers to technology adoption and drive commercialisation.
conditional_criteria: Must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.; Must be led by a UK Research and Innovation eligible organisation at the head of partnerships or consortia, including at least one commercial or industry co-location partner and one local or combined authority or equivalent economic development body

name: Water4All 2026 call: sustainable water management
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants for UK-based researchers to collaborate with international partners and submit joint applications to the Water4All 2026 joint translational call for sustainable water management. The research must fall within the NERC or EPSRC remit and address topics such as integrated monitoring, nature-based approaches, and smart water infrastructure.
conditional_criteria: Transnational research consortia must include teams from a minimum of three countries financially participating in the call, including at least two different EU Member States or Horizon Europe associated countries.; The research of the UK component must be within NERC remit or EPSRC remit.
documents_required: pre-proposal; full proposal; Data management and sharing

name: Funding opportunity: Exploring the frontiers of environmental research 2026
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants for UK-based researchers to pursue early-stage, curiosity-driven environmental research that has the potential to be transformative. The full economic cost (FEC) can be between £100,000 and £200,000, with Nerc funding 80% of the FEC for a maximum duration of two years.
conditional_criteria: An applicant may appear on a maximum of two applications submitted to this opportunity and as project lead on only one.; Project co-lead (international) can be based in a Norwegian institution under the UKRI and Research Council of Norway Money Follows Cooperation agreement.
documents_required: Facility form (if applicable)

name: UKRI: Integration of AI/HPC with quantum computing
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC) and Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC)
summary: This funding opportunity provides research grants to integrate quantum computing with classical high-performance computing (HPC) and AI workflows. It is open to UK research organisations eligible for EPSRC funding to develop application-driven end-to-end hybrid workflows.
conditional_criteria: You may be named as a project lead in no more than one application.; Projects must secure at least 1:1 leverage from public or private funding sources across its lifetime.

name: CoSTAR Showcase Labs: Createch infrastructure and commercialisation
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants up to £4 million to establish CoSTAR Showcase Labs, driving infrastructure, commercialisation, and R&D in the UK's creative technology and screen and performance industries. It is open to UK research organisations eligible for AHRC funding leading partnerships.
conditional_criteria: Must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.; Lead application must include at least one commercial or industry co-location partner and one local or combined authority or equivalent economic development body or enterprise agency.

name: MRC Centre of Research Excellence: round five: outline application
summary: This grant funds UK-based research organisations to establish MRC Centres of Research Excellence (MRC CoREs) tackling complex and interdisciplinary health challenges. Awards last for up to 14 years, initially funded for seven years with full economic costs up to £26.25 million.
conditional_criteria: Businesses, charity and third sector organisations, and international research organisations cannot apply as project lead or project co-lead.; International researchers can apply as part of the leadership team as an international co-project lead.
documents_required: Outline application

name: Economic research on the returns to R&D investment
summary: This funding opportunity supports research that helps develop new measurements and consensus estimates of the return on investments in research and development (R&D). It provides grants of up to £308,000 for full economic costs (funded at 80% by UKRI) for projects lasting 24 months based at eligible UK research organisations.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can apply as 'project co-lead (international)'

name: Unlocking advanced capabilities in conservation and heritage science
summary: This funding opportunity supports the enhancement of conservation and heritage science infrastructure by building sustainable national capability, improving access to nationally significant facilities, and addressing unmet user demand. It provides grants for capital investment and collaborative innovation with industry partners. Projects can request a full economic cost of up to £1.5 million for a maximum duration of 24 months.
conditional_criteria: Must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

name: Transformative sustainable AI technologies
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants for speculative and high-risk research projects aimed at delivering a step change in the sustainability of future AI systems. It is open to research groups, individuals, and research technical professionals based at UK research organisations eligible for UKRI funding.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can only apply as 'project co-lead (international)' via specific agreements such as UKRI-RCN Money Follows Cooperation agreement or UKRI-IIASA agreement.

name: EPSRC Strategic Infrastructure outlines: September 2026
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants to UK research organisations to purchase and set-up strategic infrastructure or support existing infrastructure. It aims to improve UK scientific capability and enable cutting-edge research aligning with national priorities.
conditional_criteria: Route two applications require prior approval from the relevant EPSRC theme lead.; Projects with a duration of more than 36 months require prior approval from the Research Infrastructure team.
documents_required: quotes for equipment costing more than £138,000

name: Research Infrastructure Renewal
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants to renew, replace, and enhance existing research infrastructure and facility capabilities that support the wider environmental science community. Awards range from £300,000 to £1,000,000 and cover 100% of the full economic cost.
conditional_criteria: Each individual based at an eligible organisation may submit only one application as project lead and one application as project co-lead.; Projects wishing to request funding amounts outside the £300,000 to £1,000,000 limits must submit a request via email and have NERC approval prior to submitting the application.; Applicants proposing investments that affect UKRI-owned or supported facilities, estates or operational infrastructure are encouraged to contact NERC before submitting an application.
documents_required: delivery schedule; expenditure profile

name: Funding opportunity: Next generation artificial intelligence (AI): explainable AI
provider: UK Research and Innovation (Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council)
summary: This funding opportunity supports speculative and high-risk fundamental research with the potential to deliver high reward and a step change in the explainability of future artificial intelligence (AI) systems. It provides grants up to £602,500 for projects lasting up to 24 months, with applications particularly welcomed from early and mid-career UK researchers.
conditional_criteria: International researchers can only apply as project co-lead (international) as part of applications making use of the UKRI-RCN Money Follows Cooperation agreement or the UKRI-IIASA agreement.

name: AI supported research using UKRI social science data (invite only)
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants for innovative AI-supported research using UKRI social science data infrastructures. It is open by invitation only to project leads who participated in the specific sandpit event held in June 2026 at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.
conditional_criteria: Must have participated in the AI supported research using UKRI social science data sandpit held in Manchester on 23 to 24 June 2026; Must be invited to apply; Must utilise at least one specified ESRC or UKRI data infrastructure
documents_required: Letters of support; Data management and sharing plan

name: Pre-announcement: Open-source semiconductor security platform development
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This funding opportunity supports targeted one-year research projects to develop an open-source hardware security research platform, strengthening the UK's capability to design, test, and assure secure hardware. It is open to UK research organisations eligible for EPSRC funding, providing up to £240,000 per award (80% of full economic cost).
conditional_criteria: Projects must be led by a project lead who satisfies the EPSRC standard eligibility rules.; Applications cannot include a project co-lead (international).

name: Advancing atmospheric and aerial autonomy
summary: This funding opportunity provides proof-of-concept grants to develop, integrate, deploy, and demonstrate innovative autonomous solutions for atmospheric science or autonomous aerial systems for environmental applications. It is open to UK research organisations eligible for NERC funding to support projects lasting between three and 12 months.
conditional_criteria: International collaborators should be included as project partners; international project co-lead costs are not funded.

name: EPSRC new investigator award: applicant-led mode
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
fields: computer_science; data_science_ai; electrical_engineering; mechanical_aerospace_engineering; civil_environmental_engineering; chemical_materials_engineering; mathematics_statistics; physics_astronomy; chemistry; earth_climate_sciences; biology_life_sciences; biomedical_sciences; energy_sustainability
summary: This funding opportunity supports early-career researchers in transitioning to research independence by developing an independent research vision and leading a project team. It funds 80% of the full economic cost (FEC) of the project with no upper limit on the total grant value or project duration.
conditional_criteria: Must be your first application to EPSRC as a project lead.; Must consider yourself to be an early-career individual with capacity to use the funds to transition to independence.; Must not have been the project lead or equivalent on any grant, funded project or programme that was a single award valued at over £175,000 FEC.; Must not have held a position where you supervised postdoctoral staff for more than 12-months (cumulative).; Must not hold, or have previously held, a comparable grant designed to support early independence and leadership.; If on a fixed-term contract, the research organisation must confirm the contract will last at least until the end date of the grant.
documents_required: Application submitted via the UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) Funding Service

name: John Monash Foundation Scholarships
summary: The John Monash Foundation Scholarships provide funding for outstanding Australian graduates to undertake postgraduate study at overseas universities. The scholarship offers a stipend of $100,000 per year for up to three years, along with potential partial or full fee waivers at select world-class universities.
conditional_criteria: Applicants who have been successful in securing a Rhodes, Fulbright or Ramsay scholarship are not eligible for a John Monash Scholarship.

name: Research Training Program Scholarship
provider: Australian Commonwealth Government and the University of Melbourne
summary: The Research Training Program Scholarship provides a full fee offset and living allowance for high-achieving domestic and international graduate research students undertaking a Masters by Research or doctoral degree at the University of Melbourne. It supports future and current students with benefits including tuition remission, living stipends, and relocation grants.
conditional_criteria: The Research Training Program Scholarship (Fee Offset) is offered to all domestic students.; The Research Training Program Scholarship (Stipend and Fee Offset) is offered to domestic and international students ranked highest by relevant selection panels based on their academic results for prior study and their research potential in their fie

name: Indigenous Commonwealth Scholarships
summary: The Indigenous Commonwealth Scholarship program is provided by the Australian Government and offered to Indigenous students enrolling in undergraduate or graduate coursework. It assists with education, training, relocation, and accommodation costs through allowances ranging from $8,000 to $36,000.
conditional_criteria: Preference is given to students from remote or regional areas and students who are financially disadvantaged.; Must be an Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander person

name: Fulbright Scholarship
career_levels: masters; phd_candidate; postdoc; early_career; mid_career; senior
summary: The Fulbright Scholarship offers unique opportunities for Australian students and scholars to study, research, and build long-term collaborations with U.S. universities. It provides varying benefits such as a monthly stipend, tuition allowances, airfares, and health insurance depending on the level of study.
conditional_criteria: Dependent allowance if applicable; Full tuition allowance applies only to Fulbright Future award

name: ANU Vice-Chancellor’s International Achievement Award
summary: The ANU Vice-Chancellor’s International Achievement Award offers a 20% discount on first-year tuition fees to attract academically capable international students from specified countries and regions. The scholarship is available for eligible undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs at The Australian National University.
residency_required: China; Taiwan; Hong Kong SAR; Macau SAR; Japan; Mongolia; Republic of Korea; The Democratic People’s Republic of Korea
conditional_criteria: Must be an international student.; Must be a new commencing student or a continuing student who has received an offer of admission to a higher AQF level of studies.; Undergraduate applicants must have a Selection Rank of 85 (or equivalent) or above.; Postgraduate applicants must have a minimum GPA of 5.5 (or equivalent).; Must not be the recipient of an external sponsorship that covers all or part of the students tuition fees at the University.

name: Fay Marles Scholarship
summary: The Fay Marles Scholarship is offered to domestic students enrolling in a graduate research degree who are experiencing disadvantaged circumstances. The scholarship provides a living allowance and relocation grant for up to 2 years for Masters by research or 3.5 years for Doctoral degrees.
conditional_criteria: Experiencing disadvantaged circumstances
documents_required: personal statement; supporting documents addressing any compassionate and compelling circumstances

name: Frederick Blake Shepherd Scholarship
summary: The Frederick Blake Shepherd Scholarship is offered to graduate research students with a physical disability at the University of Melbourne. It provides a living allowance and a relocation grant for up to 2 years for Master by research students or up to 3.5 years for Doctoral degree students.
conditional_criteria: Have a physical disability; Have applied for and received an offer for a graduate research degree commencing in the year for which the scholarship is awarded; Have applied for the Fay Marles Scholarship

name: Rhodes Scholarships (Australia)
summary: Established in 1903, the Rhodes Scholarship is an international scholarship program offering nine scholarships to Australians to enrol in graduate study at the University of Oxford. It provides a 100% fee remission and a stipend of at least $38,000 for one or more years.

name: Fulbright U.S. Student Program
summary: The Fulbright U.S. Student Program provides grants for English Teaching Assistantships or Study/Research projects in over 150 countries worldwide. It funds project and living expenses for current juniors, seniors, recent graduates, current graduate students, or alumni.
conditional_criteria: Study/Research candidates must secure an in-country affiliation.; Language requirements varies by country
documents_required: statement of grant purpose; personal statement; online application and essays

name: Consolidator Grant
summary: The ERC Consolidator Grant supports mid-career researchers of any nationality with 5-15 years of experience since PhD completion to consolidate their independence by establishing or strengthening a research team in Europe. Grants of up to €2 million are awarded for a period of 5 years.
conditional_criteria: Eligibility can be extended for reasons such as maternity, paternity, or parental leave, illness, national service, clinical training, natural disasters, asylum, or for victims of gender-based violence or any other form of violence.
documents_required: administrative forms; research proposal; supplementary documents

name: Postdoctoral Fellowships
summary: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Postdoctoral Fellowships support experienced researchers holding a PhD to carry out research activities abroad, acquire new skills, and develop their careers. The fellowships are divided into European Postdoctoral Fellowships and Global Postdoctoral Fellowships, covering living, mobility, and research costs.
conditional_criteria: For Global Postdoctoral Fellowships, only nationals or long-term residents of EU Member States or Horizon Europe Associated Countries can apply.; For Postdoctoral Fellowships in research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme, researchers need to be nationals or long-term residents of an EU Member State or a Euratom Associated Country.
documents_required: MSCA work programme; general annexes; guide for applicants; specific FAQs; application and evaluation forms

name: ERC Plus Grant
summary: The ERC Plus Grant supports outstanding researchers from Europe and worldwide with bold ideas for transformative research that go beyond regular ERC programmes. It awards up to €7 million for a duration of four to seven years to principal investigators addressing major scientific challenges.
conditional_criteria: Must commit to dedicate at least 30% of working time to the project; Must spend minimum 50% of working time in the EU or an associated country; Research must be conducted in a public or private research organisation (Host Institution) in an EU Member State or associated country
documents_required: administrative forms; research proposal; supplementary documents

name: Harry S. Truman Scholarship
summary: The Harry S. Truman Scholarship provides up to $30,000 for graduate or professional study for juniors or students in a five-year program interested in a career in the public sector.
conditional_criteria: Students in a five-year program may apply in their third or fourth year.
