summary: EPSRC programme grants provide flexible funding for up to six years to world-leading research groups addressing significant major research challenges across the engineering and physical sciences remit. The scheme supports collaborative teams of internationally recognised scientists and engineers focusing on strategic research themes.
conditional_criteria: Applications are paused from 1 December 2025 for energy and decarbonisation (clean growth), manufacturing and circular economy and quantum technologies.; A project co-lead (international) can be based in a Norwegian institution under the UKRI and Research Council of Norway Money Follows Cooperation agreement.
documents_required: Strategic vision and fit to programme grant scheme PDF document

name: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Music and Dance Scholarship
summary: This scholarship supports Hong Kong young talents of outstanding calibre in music and dance to pursue a Master's degree or a Doctoral degree at world-renowned institutions outside Hong Kong. It covers tuition fees, living allowance, and airfare.

name: Priority Programmes
summary: Priority Programmes give clear impetus to the advancement of science and the humanities through coordinated multi-location funding for important new topics. As a rule, programmes receive funding for a maximum of six years, split into two funding periods of three years each.
conditional_criteria: Proposals can be submitted directly by the foreign researcher to the DFG if the project abroad makes an important additional contribution to achieving the goals of the research group.

name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Research Students
summary: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship supports awardees in studying graduate courses at Japanese universities as Research Students, either as regular or non-regular students. It covers entrance fees, full tuition, a monthly allowance, and airfare for eligible residents.
conditional_criteria: Applicants of other nationalities should contact the Embassy/Consulate of Japan in their home countries for details.

name: Summer Internship Program in Kashiwa (UTSIP Kashiwa)
summary: UTSIP Kashiwa is a seven-week summer program that provides hands-on research internship opportunities in the fields of natural sciences and social sciences for academically motivated undergraduate students. Participants are assigned to a laboratory to conduct a research project under faculty guidance while receiving a scholarship and accommodations.

name: Funding opportunity: Work with US-based researchers on environmental science: NERC-NSF lead agency
summary: This funding opportunity allows UK and US-based researchers to submit a collaborative research application to either the National Science Foundation (NSF) or the Natural Environment Research Council (NERC) under existing funding programmes. Successful UK-based researchers are supported by NERC, while US-based researchers are supported by NSF.
conditional_criteria: UK-based applicants must be in a role that meets UKRI individual eligibility requirements and based at a UK research organisation eligible for NERC funding.; US-based applicants must be eligible for funding from the relevant NSF solicitations.
documents_required: Expression of interest form; NSF budget form; NERC budget form

name: Gilbert P. Whitley Memorial Student Award
summary: The Gilbert P. Whitley Memorial Student Award is presented to encourage and support high quality oral presentations by students at the Australian Society for Fish Biology's annual conference. It includes both junior and senior categories, each offering a monetary prize of $600. The award is sponsored by the Fisheries Research and Development Corporation.
conditional_criteria: Junior award may be made to a student for a presentation of work completed as part of a B.Sc., Honours, or M.Sc. (or Graduate Diploma at judges' discretion), presented during or within one year of completion.; Senior award may be made to a student for a presentation of work completed as part of a M.Sc. or Ph.D research project, presented during or within one year of completion, and within 7 years of completing a first degree.

name: Sir Edward Youde Memorial Fellowships for Overseas Studies
summary: This fellowship supports Hong Kong permanent residents in pursuing overseas postgraduate studies for doctoral or master's degrees. It provides up to HK$300,000 per year for a tenure of up to 3 years for doctoral degrees and up to 2 years for master's degrees.

name: Science Tokyo Support Program for Doctoral Students / Science Tokyo BOOST
summary: The Science Tokyo Support Program for Doctoral Students (Science Tokyo BOOST) supports doctoral students pursuing a doctorate without financial burden by providing a research incentive grant equivalent to living expenses and support for research expenses for up to three years. Supported students also participate in initiatives to improve research skills and support career paths, including off-campus study opportunities.

name: UK International Ocean Drilling Programme moratorium awards
summary: This funding opportunity provides grants to undertake research associated with an IODP3 expedition or SPARC project for invited members of science teams. It covers post-cruise moratorium research, time offshore, onshore science parties, and related travel and subsistence costs.
conditional_criteria: Must be invited following selection as a member of science teams for IODP3 drilling, coring, or SPARC expeditions.; Applications must be led by a project lead from an eligible UK institution.; Research and innovation associates or PhD students should be named researchers on the application rather than project leads.

name: Scholarship
summary: The Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung provides scholarships for undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral students across all fields of study who live in Germany and study at a German university. The award offers monthly stipends ranging from 992 € to 1.500 € along with health care cost refunds and potential family allowances. Applicants must demonstrate a very good command of German, socio-political commitment, and good academic performance.
conditional_criteria: Very good command of German / proof of sufficient German language skills; Applications must be submitted in German; Enrolment at a state or state-recognised university, higher education institution or university of applied sciences in Germany; Good performance in school or with course of studies; Socio-political commitment; Identification with the fundamental values of social democracy
documents_required: first graded performance records (for Bachelor's students)

name: DLR-DAAD Research Fellowship Programme
summary: The DLR-DAAD Research Fellowship Programme funds highly-qualified foreign graduate and doctoral students, postdoctoral researchers, and senior scientists to conduct research at institutes of the German Aerospace Center (DLR). It provides varying monthly stipends and allowances depending on the career level of the fellow.
conditional_criteria: Type A – have completed a first qualifying degree and must be enrolled in a Master's programme; Type B – have completed their studies or research with a university degree not more than six years ago; Type C – have completed their studies with a doctorate/PhD not more than two years ago; Type D – applicants are working in higher education or at a research institute and should generally hold a doctorate/PhD; Type E – PhD applicants must be currently enrolled in PhD studies; Postdoc applicants must have completed a doctorate not more than two years ago
documents_required: Online application form; Cover page; Statement of the reasons for applying; Complete curriculum vitae

name: John Glover Travel Fund Bursaries
summary: This fund assists full-time Australian and New Zealand students in attending the annual meeting of the Australian Society for Fish Biology. Travel bursaries provide a minimum of $100 up to 50% of travel costs to and from the annual conference.
conditional_criteria: Must be ASFB student member at the time of the conference.; Supported students must present an oral or poster presentation at the conference.; Funds will be awarded for interstate and international travel, or for intrastate travel of over 500 km, and preference will be given to students travelling the greatest distance.
documents_required: letter of support from their supervisor; abstract

name: Croucher Fellowships for Postdoctoral Research
fields: biology_life_sciences; physics_astronomy; chemistry; mathematics_statistics; computer_science; medicine_clinical
summary: The Croucher Fellowships for Postdoctoral Research support and develop talented Hong Kong early-career researchers aiming to become next-generation leaders in natural sciences, technology, and medicine. The fellowship provides maintenance allowance, airfare, and an annual fellowship research allowance for up to 2 years.

name: Promotion Funding
summary: This programme provides financial and non-material support for up to 200 international PhD students pursuing their doctorates in Germany. It particularly focuses on research topics related to the Heinrich-Böll-Stiftung's key issues such as justice, human rights, ecology, and socio-ecological transformation.
conditional_criteria: Bildungsinländer who were educated in Germany and EU nationals are funded with funds from the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space.; Non-EU nationals are funded by the Federal Foreign Office, with a focus on DAC countries.; Students who are parents, severely disabled, or chronically ill may request an extension of up to one year.

name: President’s award
summary: Nagoya University's President's Award honors degree-seeking undergraduate or graduate students, or student groups, who demonstrate excellent qualifications and creativity through academic study, extracurricular activities, or social contributions. Awardees receive a Certificate of Commendation and a 50,000 yen cash prize.
conditional_criteria: Has received an excellent evaluation in extracurricular activities or has made a significant positive contribution to the reputation of Nagoya University.; Has received an excellent evaluation in activities that contribute to society, such as volunteer activities or international exchange activities, or has made a major positive contribution to the reputation of Nagoya University.; Has made a significant positive contribution to Nagoya University through ongoing extracurricular activities.; If a person or group has received this award in the past, the activities this time must be particularly noteworthy.

name: Jordanian Graduate Student Scholarship
summary: The Jordanian Graduate Student Scholarship provides financial support to Jordanian master's and doctoral students whose programs focus on Jordan's cultural heritage. The award assists with the annual costs of their academic programs during the period of June 1 through May 31.
documents_required: Completed application form; Project proposal narrative (up to 500 words, not including bibliography); Transcripts(s) (first-year graduate students should submit both graduate and undergraduate transcripts); One recommendation that must be from academic advisor

name: PhD fellowships
summary: The Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds (BIF) awards PhD fellowships to European citizens working in Europe or overseas and to non-European citizens pursuing their PhD projects in Europe. The PhD projects must be experimental, in the field of basic biomedical research, and aimed at elucidating basic biological phenomena of human life and acquiring new scientific knowledge.
conditional_criteria: European citizens working in Europe or overseas and non-European citizens pursuing their PhD projects in Europe are eligible.; First university entrance qualification must not have been completed more than 8 years (96 months) ago.; If you have begun your project more than six months prior to the deadline, you are no longer eligible to apply.; If two candidates from the same laboratory apply at the same time, only one of them may receive a fellowship.
deadline_text: February 1, June 1, and October 1 of each year

name: Outstanding Graduate Student Award
summary: The Nagoya University Outstanding Graduate Student Award recognizes selected doctoral students who demonstrate excellence in both character and academic research. Recipients receive a certificate and a 500,000 yen incentive scholarship.
conditional_criteria: Must be enrolled for a period not exceeding the standard minimum duration of studies; Must display excellence in both character and academic research; Must be recommended by the Dean of their graduate school and their academic advisor

name: Mellon/ACLS Dissertation Innovation Fellowship
summary: The Mellon/ACLS Dissertation Innovation Fellowship supports early-stage doctoral students pursuing innovative approaches to dissertation research in the humanities and interpretive social sciences. It provides a base stipend of $42,000 for one year, plus additional funds for research, development, and external mentorship.
conditional_criteria: Must have completed at least two years and all required coursework in the PhD program by the start of the fellowship term.; Must not have advanced to PhD candidacy/ABD status prior to January 1, 2026.; Must intend to complete the dissertation after May 31, 2029.
documents_required: Completed application form; Proposal; One-page timeline; Bibliography; Short personal statement; Brief work sample; One letter of recommendation; Statement from the applicant's institution

name: The Branco Weiss Fellowship
summary: The Branco Weiss Fellowship supports courageous postdocs whose projects depart from mainstream research and who engage in a dialogue on relevant social, cultural, political, or economic issues. It provides funding for up to five years to cover legitimate costs of research including salary, equipment, travel, and consumables.
conditional_criteria: Delays after attaining the PhD due to parental leave, illness, or accident can extend the PhD eligibility window by up to 1 year in total, provided official confirmation is sent via email before submitting the application.
documents_required: proposal

name: Frederick-Wenger Memorial Fellowship
summary: The Frederick-Wenger Memorial Fellowship assists Jordanian undergraduate or graduate students with the cost of their education at a higher education institution within Jordan. Two fellowships of $2,000 each are awarded annually to help cover educational expenses such as tuition, registration fees, course or reference material, and transportation.
conditional_criteria: Graduate students must submit a project proposal narrative and a recommendation from their academic advisor.; First-year graduate students must submit both graduate and undergraduate transcripts.; Undergraduate students must provide proof of current enrollment and two transcripts.
documents_required: Application form; Transcripts; Project proposal narrative (for graduate students); Proof of current enrollment (for undergraduate students)

name: EPSRC Programme grant full proposal
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council
fields: electrical_engineering; mechanical_aerospace_engineering; civil_environmental_engineering; chemical_materials_engineering; mathematics_statistics; physics_astronomy; chemistry; earth_climate_sciences; energy_sustainability
summary: EPSRC Programme grants provide flexible funding to world-leading research groups addressing significant major research challenges across engineering and physical sciences. The funding brings together internationally recognised scientists or engineers to focus on a strategic research theme for up to six years.
conditional_criteria: Must have been invited following a successful outline application; International co-lead role restricted to UKRI-RCN Money Follows Cooperation agreement or UKRI-IIASA agreement
documents_required: Full proposal application

name: Tailwind for Talents: Scholarships for Graduates and PhD students
summary: This scholarship programme supports international graduate and PhD students from DAC countries who intend to pursue a Master's degree or PhD in Germany. Funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) and the Federal Foreign Office (AA), it aims to foster equal opportunities and equitable access to education.
conditional_criteria: Priority is given to applicants from DAC countries who have not yet taken up residence in Germany at the time of their application.
documents_required: Application for students (PDF); Application for PhD (PDF)

name: Jacobs CIFAR Research Fellowship Program
provider: Jacobs Foundation and Canadian Institute for Advanced Research (CIFAR)
fields: education; psychology; economics; social_sciences; computer_science; humanities_arts; biology_life_sciences
summary: The Jacobs CIFAR Research Fellowship Program offers fellowships to early- and mid-career researchers dedicated to improving the learning and development of children and youth worldwide. Funding is awarded directly to the fellow's institution over a three-year period to cover a portion of the salary and research support costs.

name: Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds PhD fellowships
summary: The Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds provides PhD fellowships to support outstanding basic research in biomedicine. The selection process evaluates the candidate's achievements, the scientific quality of the proposed research project, and the host laboratory.
conditional_criteria: Re-submission is possible only under certain circumstances, and only after consultation with the BIF.

name: 2026/27 FASP (Grant/Loan) and/or NLSPS (Non-means-tested Loan)
provider: Student Finance Office, Working Family and Student Financial Assistance Agency
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance through grants and/or loans for full-time local undergraduate students taking up full-time locally-accredited self-financing post-secondary education programmes in Hong Kong. Applicants must meet specific residency requirements.
conditional_criteria: Student visa holders are NOT eligible
documents_required: signed declaration; supporting documents

name: Master's Program in Taxation Policy and Management
summary: This two-year Master's program at Keio University is designed for tax professionals from developing countries to study taxation policy and management. Admitted students can apply for scholarships from the World Bank (JJ/WBGSP) and the Asian Development Bank (ADB-JSP).
conditional_criteria: Show future commitment to continuing their careers in tax service in their home countries.; Work experiences are relevant to development-related topics, as indicated by the World Bank or Asian Development Bank.; Must be from an eligible developing country to qualify for the World Bank or ADB scholarships.
documents_required: application documents

name: CNC/IUPAC Travel Awards
summary: The CNC/IUPAC Travel Awards support young Canadian chemists working at Canadian institutions within 10 years of receiving their PhD by funding travel to present a paper at an IUPAC-sponsored conference.
documents_required: Curriculum Vitae; Letters of Reference; Cover letter

name: Momentum – Funding for Recently Tenured Professors
summary: The Momentum initiative provides funding to academics three to five years after taking up their first tenured professorship to advance the content and strategic development of their professorship. It offers support across two phases (up to 850,000 Euro for the first phase and up to 200,000 Euro for the second phase) to foster new research approaches and broaden perspectives, excluding classical project funding.
conditional_criteria: Applications are open to professors at Universities in Germany, Art and Music colleges, insofar as they conduct academic research, and Universities of Education in Baden-Württemberg.
documents_required: CV-Template; proposal video; outline proposal; template full application

name: CSC-ABCChem Travel Awards
summary: The CSC-ABCChem Travel Awards support Canadian early-career researchers to attend and present at the Atlantic Basin Conference on Chemistry (ABCChem) 2026 in Rio de Janeiro. Eligible costs include conference registration, flights, accommodations, and other expenses directly associated with attending the congress, up to $3,000 each.
conditional_criteria: Must be members of the Canadian Society for Chemistry (CSC).
documents_required: Cover Letter; Curriculum Vitae; Copy or Copies of Accepted ABCChem Abstract(s)

name: Funding opportunity: ESRC responsive mode: working with Luxembourg researchers round two
summary: This programme funds collaborative social sciences research between UK and Luxembourg researchers. The UK part of the full economic cost can range from £350,000 to £1 million, with ESRC funding 80% and FNR paying justified costs for Luxembourg participants.
conditional_criteria: Luxembourg partners must be based at an eligible institution in Luxembourg and contact FNR to confirm eligibility.; Project leads from non-UK organisations are not eligible to apply for the UK part of funding.; Associated studentships cannot be funded under this funding opportunity.
documents_required: project plan form; budget spreadsheet; justification of costs form

name: The Arnold L. and Lois S. Graves Awards in the Humanities
summary: The Arnold L. and Lois S. Graves Awards in the Humanities recognize outstanding accomplishment in actual teaching among early-career faculty in California, Oregon, and Washington. The awards provide support for transformative experiences and projects designed to enhance teaching ability in the classroom.
conditional_criteria: Must be nominated by an eligible institution in California, Oregon, and Washington (each eligible institution may nominate one faculty member per competition).

name: Studien- und Promotionsstipendien
summary: Das Studienwerk der Heinrich-Böll-Stiftung vergibt Studien- und Promotionsstipendien an deutsche und internationale Studierende und Promovierende. Bewerbungsverfahren finden zweimal jährlich statt mit Fristen zum 1. März und 1. September.
conditional_criteria: Studierende im Erststudium bis zum 3. Fachsemester; Vorrang haben Studierende, die BAföG beziehen bzw. voraussichtlich beziehen werden; Promovierende aus dem Nicht-EU-Ausland: Vorrang haben Bewerber*innen aus DAC-Ländern, die sich zum Zeitpunkt der Bewerbung noch im Ausland befinden
documents_required: Fachgutachten; Referenz zum gesellschaftlichen Engagement

name: Fulbright Generation250 Scholarship (Australian Scholars)
fields: earth_climate_sciences; civil_environmental_engineering; chemical_materials_engineering; politics_international_relations; data_science_ai; electrical_engineering; physics_astronomy; mechanical_aerospace_engineering; energy_sustainability
summary: The Fulbright Generation250 Scholarship supports senior Australian scholars to undertake high-impact research and collaboration in the United States in areas of shared strategic, technological, and economic priority. The award provides a monthly stipend for up to 4 months, international travel allowance, health benefits, and support for orientation events.
conditional_criteria: Must have a letter of invitation from proposed host institution in the U.S.; Must be at associate or full professor level with relevant disciplinary experience.; Must propose a project aligned with one or more of the identified priority areas.; Must not have already commenced this project in the U.S.
documents_required: letter of invitation from proposed host institution in the U.S.

name: Funding opportunity: EPSRC discipline hopping in ICT, Nov 2023: responsive mode
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This grant funds researchers to 'hop' into or from ICT research areas to learn new skills, develop collaborations, or apply their expertise in a new discipline. It covers 80% of the full economic cost of projects lasting between three and 24 months.
conditional_criteria: Must be hopping into or from one of the ICT research areas covered by this funding opportunity.
documents_required: Vision and Approach PDF document; Letters or emails of support

name: Studienstipendien - Masterstudium für alle wissenschaftlichen Fächer
summary: This scholarship programme offers graduates the opportunity to continue their academic education in Germany with a postgraduate or Master's degree course in all academic subjects at a state or state-recognized higher education institution. It provides a monthly stipend of 992 euros, study allowances, and insurance coverage for a duration between 10 and 24 months.
conditional_criteria: Förderung für ein bereits in Deutschland begonnenes Masterstudium ist nicht möglich.; Für künstlerische Fachbereiche sowie den Fachbereich Architektur bietet der DAAD andere Programme an.

name: Forschungsstipendien in Deutschland
summary: This programme funds research stays in Germany for doctoral candidates and early-career postdocs from abroad. It supports a research project at a state or state-recognized higher education institution or non-university research institute in Germany.
conditional_criteria: Zusatzleistungen bei Vorliegen einer Behinderung oder chronischer Erkrankung; Mietbeihilfen und Familienzuschläge nur bei einer Förderdauer von mehr als sechs Monaten

name: Change! Fellowships
summary: The Change! Fellowships fund researchers from all disciplines who want to research transformation processes jointly with partners outside of academia. The fellowship supports your own position with 1.5 to 1.8 million euros for a duration of 4 to 5 years.
conditional_criteria: Junior professors and professors up to 3 years after taking up their first tenured professorship are also eligible.; Involvement of at least 1 to max. 3 partners from outside of academia is required.; Lead applicants must be affiliated with a German university or research institution or attach a statement with their application confirming employment and administration of third-party funds.
documents_required: Application template; CV Template; Institutional declaration (scientific institution); Partner outside of academia: Letter of intent; Partner outside of academia: affiliation and CV; Data Management Plan

name: China-ASEAN Marine Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Natural Resources (MNR) of the People’s Republic of China
summary: The China-ASEAN Marine Scholarship funds international graduate students from ASEAN member states to pursue master's or PhD degrees in ocean-related fields in China. It provides full coverage of tuition fees, monthly living allowances, free on-campus accommodation, and comprehensive medical insurance.
nationality_allowed: Brunei Darussalam; Cambodia; Indonesia; Lao PDR; Malaysia; Myanmar; Philippines; Singapore; Thailand; Vietnam
conditional_criteria: Applicants applying for a master's degree must hold an undergraduate degree and be under the age of 35.; Applicants applying for a PhD degree must hold a master's degree and be under the age of 40.
documents_required: Application Form for China-ASEAN Oceanic Scholarship; Passport copy; Degree Certificate; Official Transcripts; Language Proficiency Requirements; Research Proposal; Two recommendation letters; Form for Provisional Acceptance of International Student by ZJU Professor; No-criminal record report; Documentation on nationality

name: Data Reuse – Additional Funding for the Preparation and Storage of Research Data (Open Science)
summary: This programme provides additional funding to current or recent grantees of the Volkswagen Foundation to prepare research data for reuse and make it available in a publicly accessible, suitable repository. The funding covers up to 100,000 Euro for the preparation and storage of research data. Applicants must have completed their doctorate and submit applications up to 6 months after the end of their previously funded project.
conditional_criteria: Previous funding by the Foundation (current grantees or funded in approximately the last 6 months).; Applications can be submitted up to 6 months after the end of the project.
documents_required: Letter of support from the target repository; Application via Funding Platform

name: EPSRC overseas travel grant: Nov 2023: responsive mode
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: This grant provides funding for visits overseas to learn new techniques or form and develop collaborations in any area within the EPSRC remit. It awards 80% of the full economic cost (FEC) of the project.
conditional_criteria: Must be within the remit of Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC); Single visit not to exceed six months or multiple visits totalling up to 12 months
documents_required: Purpose document; Project partners letters of support

name: Navigating a Transforming World Order: Fellowships on Security and Technology
summary: This funding programme offers postdoctoral fellowships for early career researchers up to 5 years after completing their PhD to conduct research on the nexus of security and technology with a European perspective. The programme provides a maximum of 450,000 EUR for up to 3 years, supporting a holistic understanding of security, cross-sectoral exchange, and policy advice.
conditional_criteria: Lead applicants must be affiliated with a German university or research institution or attach a statement with their application confirming employment and administration of third-party funds.; Data management plan required if the project involves the generation of large volumes of data.
documents_required: Application template; CV template; Data Management Plan

name: Travel grants
summary: The Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds provides travel grants for junior scientists such as PhD students, medical students during their doctoral thesis, postdocs, and graduates pursuing a PhD project. The grants support short-term experimental projects and practical courses in basic biomedical research. Research stays must not exceed three months.
conditional_criteria: For PhD and MD students as well as graduates, the university entrance qualification must not have been obtained more than 11 years prior to the planned research visit.; For postdocs, the university entrance qualification must not have been obtained more than 13 years prior to the planned research visit.; European citizens must work in Europe or overseas, while non-European citizens must perform their project in Europe or use the travel grant to work in Europe.

name: Innovation and Technology Scholarship
provider: Innovation and Technology Commission and The Hongkong and Shanghai Corporation Limited (HSBC)
summary: The Innovation and Technology Scholarship recognizes outstanding non-final year local undergraduates studying any discipline by providing a scholarship and elite training opportunities. Awardees will be supported to attach to overseas or Mainland China universities between 1 June 2026 and 31 July 2027.
conditional_criteria: Must achieve a satisfactory result from any one of the specified English tests (TOEFL, IELTS, HKDSE, IB, or IGCSE); Must select one designated InnoTech Area and have innovative ideas or engage in research aligned with it; Must develop a comprehensive plan for the Overseas/Mainland China Attachment Programme
documents_required: Application form; Comprehensive plan for the Overseas/Mainland China Attachment Programme; English test score results

name: ESRC responsive mode: research grants round two
summary: This opportunity funds researcher-driven basic, applied, and strategic research from any disciplines and on any topics in ESRC’s remit, provided social sciences comprise more than 50% of the research focus. The full economic cost of projects can range from £350,000 to £1 million, with ESRC funding 80% of the cost.
conditional_criteria: Project co-leads based in non-UK research organisations can be included in research grant applications.; Business, third sector or government body project co-leads based in the UK can also be included.; Proposals can draw from the wider sciences, as long as the social sciences are more than 50% of the research focus and effort.
documents_required: Application via the UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) Funding Service

name: PhD Scholarships Program
summary: The Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation PhD scholarship supports students with an excellent academic record who are engaged in humanities and social sciences research that contributes to the advancement of Canada and society. It provides up to $50,000 per year for three years for tuition and living expenses, plus up to $20,000 per year for research and travel.

name: Additional Funding for Science Communication
summary: This funding offer supports current grantees of the Volkswagen Foundation in implementing innovative measures for science communication. It provides up to 150,000 Euro for a duration of up to 1.5 years to foster dialogical and participatory formats connecting science with non-scientific target groups.
conditional_criteria: Must be a current grantee of the Volkswagen Foundation; Applications can be submitted up to 6 months after the end of project funding; Lead applicants must be affiliated with a German university or research institution
documents_required: Application template; CV template

name: Boren Awards
summary: The Boren Awards fund the intensive study of language abroad by U.S. undergraduate or graduate students. The program supports immersive overseas language study and related research or internships in areas critical to U.S. national security.
conditional_criteria: Undergraduate STEM majors may propose summer programs of 8 weeks or longer.; Graduate students may pursue research, internships, or academic coursework alongside language study.; ROTC cadets and military reservists must be in inactive, non-drilling status during the award.
documents_required: Signed matriculation form; Application essays; Letters of affiliation (for fellows proposing research/internships)

name: Li Po Chun Charitable Trust Fund Postgraduate Scholarship
provider: Li Po Chun Charitable Trust Fund Committee
summary: The Li Po Chun Charitable Trust Fund Postgraduate Scholarship is awarded to full-time MPhil or PhD students at the University of Hong Kong who are permanent residents of Hong Kong. Selection is based on academic merit, financial need, and a well-developed sense of social awareness.
conditional_criteria: Financial need will be taken into account; Candidates would be expected to have a well developed sense of social awareness; Subject to satisfactory academic progress and availability of funds

name: Bourse aux cycles supérieurs Globalink
summary: La Bourse aux cycles supérieurs Globalink offre un soutien financier unique de 15 000 $ aux anciens stagiaires de recherche Globalink qui reviennent au Canada pour y poursuivre un programme complet de maîtrise, de doctorat ou des bourses postdoctorales auprès d'un partenaire postsecondaire de Mitacs. Ce programme a pris fin après le cycle de demandes 2024.
conditional_criteria: Seulement 2024 Stagiaire en recherche Globalink s, qui ont terminé leur stage avec succès, sont admissible pour postuler.
documents_required: Preuve d’inscription à la première session; Lettre d’admission officielle ou lettre provisoire des professeur·es; Sondage final du stage de recherche Globalink

name: PhD-Stipendien
summary: The Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds (BIF) awards PhD fellowships worldwide to outstanding junior scientists for ambitious experimental PhD projects in basic biomedical research. The fellowship includes a monthly stipend, seminars, travel grants, and access to a global network.
documents_required: Beschreibung des geplanten Forschungsprojektes

name: PATT travel claim for competitively awarded observation time
summary: This funding opportunity allows UK-based researchers to claim back travel and subsistence costs when visiting an astronomy telescope for competitively awarded science observation time. The scheme covers 100% of the full economic cost for eligible applicants.
conditional_criteria: Must be a permanent staff member or academic at an eligible UK institution; Must have been awarded observation time; Must not already hold or have access to a travel grant from PATT
documents_required: travel and subsistence request form; copy of the observation time allocation letter from the awarding body; original research proposal that the awarded observation time is supporting

name: MUSIC AUSTRALIA EXPORT DEVELOPMENT FUND: International Professional and Artistic Development (Category 2)
summary: This fund provides matched funding between $3,000 and $15,000 to support international professional development and artistic activities for Australian contemporary music artists. Eligible activities include showcases, co-writing sessions, overseas recording, residencies, and international conferences.
conditional_criteria: Must be a practising contemporary music artist (solo artist, instrumentalist, band, ensemble, electronic artist, producer, songwriter or composer); Must provide evidence of matched funding (at least 50:50 basis); Activity must meet the definition of contemporary Australian music; Activity must start between 1 January 2027 and 31 March 2027
documents_required: evidence of matched funding; support material (links or documents); letters of confirmation

name: StipendiumPlus
provider: Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF)
summary: StipendiumPlus is an association of 13 organisations for the promotion of young talent that provides intellectual and financial support to undergraduates and doctoral students in Germany. Funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF), the programmes support young people who demonstrate special talents alongside societal, political, cultural, or social commitment.
conditional_criteria: Funding opportunities are also available for international students who would like to complete a PhD at a university in Germany.

name: Bursaries to Support Learning
summary: This undergraduate bursary programme supports student members of IOM3 through their studies in materials, minerals, or mining-related disciplines. Recipients receive £1,500 for each remaining year of their undergraduate degree programme.
conditional_criteria: Must be a student member of IOM3 for a minimum of 12 months prior to application; Must be undertaking an IOM3 Accredited or Certified undergraduate degree programme in any materials, minerals or mining-related discipline; Must be at the end of their second year
documents_required: A statement from you explaining why you should be considered for the Bursary; A statement of support from your tutor; A short report (500 words max), on a sustainability-themed subject of your choice that is related to your field of study

name: Boren Scholarships
summary: Boren Scholarships provide funding for U.S. undergraduate students to study overseas in world regions critical to U.S. national security. The award covers eligible costs such as tuition and fees, room and board, travel, and books.
conditional_criteria: Must not be a citizen of the proposed overseas study location.; Must propose an overseas study program that includes at least 15-20 weekly language hours.; Must comply with the Fly America Act for air travel funded by federal funds.
documents_required: Unofficial transcripts; Study abroad program description; Two Letters of Recommendation

name: MUSIC AUSTRALIA EXPORT DEVELOPMENT FUND: International Performance and Touring Activity (Category 1)
summary: The fund provides matched funding of $5,000 to $75,000 for international tours and performances by Australian contemporary music artists. It supports emerging, breakthrough, and established acts including solo artists, bands, and producers.
conditional_criteria: Must provide evidence of matched funding on at least a 50:50 basis.; Activity must meet the definition of contemporary Australian music.
documents_required: Evidence of matched funding; Support material including web links or documents; Letters of confirmation

name: Post-PhD Research Grant
summary: This grant program funds individual research projects undertaken by doctorates in anthropology and related fields with an academic appointment in an anthropology department. The maximum grant is $25,000 to support vibrant and significant work furthering our understanding of what it means to be human.
conditional_criteria: Applicants from doctorates in related fields must have an academic appointment in anthropology.; Applicants whose research is oriented toward primatology or primate conservation must demonstrate the broader anthropological relevance of their work.; Language structure and endangered language research must be grounded in anthropological concerns.; Projects located in Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Venezuela, Crimea, Donetsk People’s Republic, Luhansk People’s Republic, and Russia require special documentation in compliance with OFAC regulations.
documents_required: Application forms and required materials online

name: Research Fellowship Programme
summary: ESA's postdoctoral Research Fellowship Programme offers young scientists and engineers the possibility to carry out advanced research for two years in disciplines related to space science, space applications, or space technology. Fellows work in ESA Establishments with a monthly salary exempt from national income tax and comprehensive social security and pension scheme benefits.
conditional_criteria: Preference will be given to applications submitted by candidates within five years of receiving their PhD.; Expatriation allowance and/or an installation allowance on arrival if you meet the conditions of entitlement.
documents_required: CV; motivation letter; research proposal

name: Humboldt Research Fellowship
summary: The Humboldt Research Fellowship enables early career and established researchers from abroad in all disciplines to carry out their own long-term research project in collaboration with an academic host of their choice at a research institution in Germany. Fellows receive a monthly stipend along with allowances for travel, family, and research costs.
conditional_criteria: Researchers from Brazil can only apply for a Capes-Humboldt Research Fellowship.
documents_required: confirmation that research facilities are available; mentoring agreement; detailed expert’s statement by an academic host

name: Initiation of International Collaboration
summary: This programme serves to establish collaborative relationships between international partners by funding bilateral workshops, trips abroad, and guest visits. It is designed for early career and established researchers who hold a doctorate and are working at a German research institution. Researchers can explore opportunities for international collaboration or prepare a concrete joint research project.

name: Ray Y Gildea Jr Award
summary: The Ray Y Gildea Jr Award supports innovation in teaching and learning in higher and secondary education in geography. Grants of up to £1,500 are typically awarded annually to educators currently employed in the higher education or secondary school sector in the UK or USA.
conditional_criteria: Higher education applicants are expected to hold a PhD at the time of applying.
documents_required: application

name: Boren Fellowships
summary: The Boren Fellowships fund graduate-level U.S. citizens to study less commonly taught languages overseas in world regions critical to U.S. interests. The award covers eligible costs including tuition, room and board, airfare, and insurance.
conditional_criteria: Boren recipients may not study overseas in a location in which they are a citizen.; If proposed language is French, Spanish, or Persian Master's program at University of Maryland, applicants will be tested to ensure they meet minimum proficiency.; An alternate study abroad program is required if a destination or language with an asterisk (Arabic, Mandarin & Russian) is chosen, with some exceptions.
documents_required: Unofficial transcript; Letter of Affiliation; Essays; Language Self-Assessment

name: Postgraduate Research Awards
summary: The Society offers awards of up to £2,500 for PhD students undertaking fieldwork or data collection to advance geographical knowledge. These grants aim to help students establish themselves in their particular field.
conditional_criteria: Preference is given to students who do not receive full funding from a research council, university or comparable levels of support from other sources for fieldwork and data collection.
documents_required: application form

name: The Wallenberg Foundation Postdoctoral Fellowships at Nanyang Technological University Singapore
summary: This fellowship provides two years of postdoctoral research funding at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore for outstanding young scientists who have earned a doctor's degree from a Swedish university. Successful Fellows receive an annual base salary, cost of living allowance, research allowance, and health insurance, with an opportunity for subsequent return funding in Sweden.
conditional_criteria: Must have a connection to a Swedish University or corresponding non-profit research organization.; Cannot be employed/Scholar at the intended host/University prior to the Wallenberg post-doc.
documents_required: applicant’s date of PhD dissertation; CV; list of publications; short personal letter; brief description of the proposed research program; description of the research profile of the intended host and supervisor; letter of invitation from the intended host; letter from the supervising professor stating actual date for exam (if applicable); two separate letters of recommendation; document confirming intent to apply for Accompanying family member allowance

name: Foreign Fulbright Program
summary: The Foreign Fulbright Program provides approximately 4,000 grants annually to foreign students and early career educators to study for a Master's or Doctorate degree, conduct research, or serve as Foreign Language Teaching Assistants in the United States. Award benefits include J-1 visa sponsorship, funding support, a health benefit plan, and enrichment activities.
conditional_criteria: Additional eligibility requirements differ by country of citizenship.; Students cannot apply for programs with clinical requirements such as dentistry, medicine, pharmacy, nursing.
documents_required: application form; supporting documents

name: ACF Boost 2027
summary: ACF Boost 2027 is a matched funding program designed to enable independent artists, small groups, and arts organisations using the Australian Cultural Fund (ACF) to leverage private sector support. Successful participants running a fundraising campaign receive a dollar-for-dollar matched funding boost of up to $5,000 for their arts and cultural project.
conditional_criteria: Must have an active ABN and be prepared to receive project funds, or have an agreement in place with an auspicing body.; Must apply with a project that falls under at least one cultural form specified in the ITAA 97.; Must be prepared and willing to run a fundraising campaign between 1 February 2027 - 30 April 2027.
documents_required: ACF Artist Profile; ACF Project submission with the Boost tickbox checked; Responses to additional questions on the project form; Project budget including ACF campaign target; Fundraising strategy and contingency strategy

name: Academy Research Fellowship
summary: The Academy Research Fellowship supports early-career researchers on fast career tracks to work independently and develop their research. The four-year funding covers the applicant's salary, research team costs, and other research costs.
conditional_criteria: Foreign researchers who already work or who will work in the Finnish scientific community may also apply for the funding.

name: Collaborate with researchers in Luxembourg
summary: This funding opportunity welcomes collaborative research applications between UK and Luxembourg researchers, co-funded by UKRI and the Fonds National de la Recherche (FNR). Joint applications are submitted to participating UKRI councils' responsive mode or standard research grant opportunities.
conditional_criteria: UK principal investigator must be employed by a UK research organisation eligible to receive funding from the participating research councils.; Luxembourg applicants need to be from FNR eligible institutions, meaning public research centres, the University of Luxembourg and public bodies, departments and establishments in Luxembourg with an authorisation to undertake research.
documents_required: INTER budget sheet (Excel workbook); INTER budget justification (Word document); project plan

name: Knowledge Transfer Partnership
summary: The Knowledge Transfer Partnership funds collaborative innovation projects between UK-based businesses and academic or research organisations, lasting between 12 and 36 months. It enables businesses to employ academic expertise and a graduate associate to deliver a specific innovation project.
conditional_criteria: If your project is using research previously funded by one of the research councils, this should be clearly stated in the relevant section within the application form.
documents_required: application form; Other-DI Costs document (if applicable)

name: Fejos Fellowship in Public Media
summary: The Fejos Fellowship in Public Media provides up to $80,000 for a 9-month stipend to support anthropologists in completing public media projects such as films, audio productions, or other creative multimodal work based on already completed research. It is designed for early-career scholars who are no more than ten years beyond their PhD.
conditional_criteria: Allowances made for periods of caregiving regarding the years since PhD limit.; Prior recipients of a Fejos Postdoctoral Fellowship are not eligible to apply.; Applicants must complete all requirements of their existing award before applying for a new award.

name: Thesiger-Oman Fellowships
summary: The Thesiger-Oman International Fellowships offer two awards of £15,000 annually to academic researchers for geographical research involving fieldwork in physical or human dimensions of arid and semi-arid environments. Applicants must be Fellows or members of the Society with at least three years' post-doctoral experience.
conditional_criteria: Preference will be given to research in the Middle East and other areas visited by Sir Wilfred Thesiger.

name: The Inter-American Foundation Research Fellowship Program

summary: The Inter-American Foundation Research Fellowship Program supports individual researchers conducting field-based research on community-led development in Latin America and the Caribbean. Each fellowship provides a $20,000 stipend for a twelve-month period.
conditional_criteria: Fellows conducting research in a country named in the Foreign Assistance Act must clear a country narcotics check and certify compliance with anti-narcotics provisions.

summary: This fellowship brings outstanding young Swedish scientists to Stanford University for one to two years of postdoctoral study and research across all disciplines. Upon their return, scholars are supported to use their experience for the benefit of Sweden.
conditional_criteria: Must have a connection to a Swedish University or corresponding non-profit research organization.; Must contact a faculty member at Stanford University and obtain a support letter from previous supervisor(s) at Swedish universities and an invitation letter from the Stanford faculty.
documents_required: applicant’s date of PhD dissertation; CV; list of publications; short personal letter; brief description of the proposed research program; description of the research profile of the intended host and supervisor; letter of invitation from the intended host; two separate letters of recommendation; budget form alternative / document indicating intent to apply for family allowance

summary: The C.A.S. Hawker Scholarship is a residential scholarship provided to young Australians for studying at universities such as the Australian National University. It is valued at up to $75,000 over three years to support students who represent the values embodied by C.A.S. Hawker.

name: ESRC responsive mode: working with Brazilian researchers round two
summary: This funding opportunity invites collaborative research proposals between UK and São Paulo, Brazil researchers in any area of the social sciences. ESRC funds 80% of the full economic cost (FEC) of the UK portion ranging from £350,000 to £1 million, while FAPESP covers justified costs for Brazilian partners.
conditional_criteria: UK project lead must be based at an organisation eligible for ESRC funding.; São Paulo-based applicants must be based at higher education and research organisations, public or non-profit, based in the State of São Paulo and eligible for FAPESP funding.
documents_required: FAPESP letter of eligibility; Copy of the SAGe application

name: AFNGA AusArt Fellowship
provider: Dr. Lee MacCormick Edwards Charitable Foundation and the American Friends of the National Gallery of Australia
summary: The AusArt Fellowship offers a one-off grant of US$30,000 for emerging visual arts practitioners to progress their graduate or postgraduate studies at a university, educational institution, or museum in the United States. It is open to visual artists, curators, art historians, administrators, and conservators who are Australian citizens or permanent residents.
conditional_criteria: Course cannot be more than 75% complete at the time of the application
documents_required: CV; letters of support; examples of work

name: Clinical Researcher Funding
summary: The Research Council of Finland funds part-time research by physicians and researchers engaged in clinical practice. The aim is to promote clinical research careers in cooperation with university hospitals and to encourage medical doctors and other clinical researchers to engage in research.
conditional_criteria: Funding will not be granted to professors or full-time university researchers (career stages I–IV).

name: Gilchrist Fieldwork Award
summary: The Gilchrist Fieldwork Award offers £15,000 to support original and challenging overseas fieldwork carried out by small teams of established researchers. The funding is intended for a single field session of high-quality research to advance geographical knowledge with strong local community and agency links.
conditional_criteria: Must be based in a UK Higher Education Institution or equivalent research establishment
documents_required: Gilchrist Fieldwork Award application form; Two references

name: Hunt Fellowship in Public Writing
summary: The Hunt Fellowship in Public Writing supports anthropologists who are writing serious nonfiction books for general audiences, providing 9 months of focused writing time and $80,000. The program is designed to encourage public writing that brings anthropological knowledge into wider conversations.
conditional_criteria: Allowances made for periods of caregiving regarding the 15-year limit beyond PhD.; Applicants whose research is oriented toward primatology or primate conservation must demonstrate the broader anthropological relevance of their work.; Work on endangered languages and language structure is supported only when grounded in anthropological concerns.
deadline_text: Letter of Interest deadline is October 15. Invited full proposals deadline is December 15.
documents_required: Letter of Interest; Full proposal (if invited)

name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks
summary: PhD candidates receive structured doctoral training within networks formed jointly by different European institutions. They can apply for positions specifically created by these networks, receiving a work contract with a salary depending on the host country, plus mobility and family allowances.
conditional_criteria: Family allowance is provided if applicable.

name: Small Research Grants
summary: Awards of up to £5,000 are provided to early career researchers for original desk or field-based research in any area of geography. The grants support individual researchers who are affiliated with a UK Higher Education Institution or equivalent research establishment.
conditional_criteria: At risk academic geographers hosted at UK institutions through programmes such as Cara are eligible to apply.
documents_required: A completed application form; A one-page CV; Two references

name: The Wallenberg Foundation Scholarship Program for Postdoctoral studies at Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Broad Institute
summary: This program brings outstanding young Swedish scientists to MIT and the Broad Institute for two years of postdoctoral studies across all disciplines. Upon completion, fellows receive support to return to Sweden and apply their experience for the benefit of the country.
conditional_criteria: If the applicant has not passed the doctorate exam at the time of the application, a letter from the supervising professor should be submitted stating the actual date for the exam.
documents_required: CV; list of publications; short personal letter; brief description of the proposed research program; description of the research profile of the intended host and supervisor; letter of invitation from the intended host; two separate letters of recommendation

name: Fellowship in Anthropology and Black Experiences
summary: This writing fellowship supports Ph.D.-holding anthropologists whose research draws on Black studies, critical race studies, diasporic Africana studies, and related fields to advance new scholarship. Fellows receive a stipend of $80,000 over nine months and participate in a writing workshop and networking designed to amplify their project's impact in the public sphere.
conditional_criteria: Prior recipients of an Anthropology and Black Experiences Fellowship or a Hunt Fellowship are not eligible to apply.; Applicants whose research is oriented toward primatology or primate conservation must demonstrate the broader anthropological relevance of their work.; The Foundation supports work on endangered languages and language structure, but only when it is grounded in anthropological concerns.; The Foundation accepts a single resubmission of a Fellowship in Anthropology and Black Experiences application that was unsuccessful in a prior funding cycle.; Grantees funded by our other programs must complete all requirements of their existing award, including submission of the final report, before applying for a new award.
documents_required: Online application forms; Required materials detailed in Application Guide

name: Imago Fellowship
summary: The Imago Fellowship supports emerging creative writers to engage deeply with the rich collections at the State Library of NSW to produce a work of fiction or non-fiction. It provides an award of $50,000 for annual research projects.

name: Monica Cole and Henrietta Hutton Research Grants
summary: Four grants of £1000 are offered annually to undergraduate and Masters students undertaking original overseas field research in physical geography or with a significant social or environmental focus. Applicants must be registered at a UK Higher Education Institution and show strong evidence of host country participation.
conditional_criteria: Must be undertaking an independent field research project (or clarify distinction if part of a larger organised expedition); Must show strong evidence of host country participation
documents_required: completed application form; one-page CV; two references

name: Travel Grants
summary: The Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds (BIF) awards travel grants to PhD students and postdoctoral researchers from all over the world conducting experimental projects in basic biomedical research. The grants help cover the expenses for travel, lodging, and course fees for short-term research stays or practical courses in Europe or overseas.
conditional_criteria: For doctoral students and postdoc applicants from countries with very low incomes, additional funds for living costs may be granted.

name: Georg Forster Research Fellowship
summary: This fellowship allows early career and experienced researchers with above-average qualifications from developing and transition countries to carry out a research project in cooperation with an academic host of their choice in Germany. The research must deal with issues relevant to the future development of the candidate's country or region of origin.
residency_required: developing countries; emerging economies; transition states
conditional_criteria: Must be cooperating with an academic host of their choice in Germany.; The research project must deal with issues of relevance to the future development of the candidate's country or region of origin.

name: Global Initiatives Grant
summary: The Global Initiatives Grant supports innovative projects in public anthropology that benefit the discipline as a whole by creating conditions for anthropologists to do better work. The program awards a single grant of up to $80,000 annually to applicants holding a Ph.D. in anthropology or a related field.
conditional_criteria: Grantees funded by other programs must complete all requirements of their existing award before applying.; Projects located in specific countries (Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Venezuela, Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Russia) require special OFAC documentation before funds are released.
documents_required: General information about you, your collaborators, and your project; An abstract of the project; Answers to six questions about your project; A budget detailing the expenses involved; A curriculum vitae for the applicant and any key collaborator

name: US Fulbright Program - Fulbright-National Geographic Award
career_levels: undergraduate; masters; phd_candidate; postdoc; early_career; mid_career; senior; industry
summary: The Fulbright-National Geographic Award Program is an enhancement award to a Fulbright Open Study/Research proposal, providing up to $20,000 in additional grant funds and resources from the National Geographic Society. It recognizes up to five individuals undertaking in-depth examinations of globally relevant issues across science, education, and storytelling.
conditional_criteria: Must be selected for a Fulbright Study/Research Grant by the eligible country for which they applied and meet the criteria of the Fulbright Study/Research requirements of the host country.
documents_required: Fulbright U.S. Student Study/Research application; Additional materials for semi-finalists

name: Funding for clinical research
summary: This funding supports scientifically high-quality clinical research projects implemented by a consortium of three or more research teams to improve clinical research skills, boost clinical research careers, and support healthcare and social welfare. The four-year funding may cover salary costs and other research costs.
conditional_criteria: A consortium or subproject PI engaged in part-time clinical patient work must be a physician or other healthcare professional who has completed a doctorate.

name: Lise Meitner Excellence Programme
summary: This programme enables female early career scientists from around the world to establish their own research group at a Max Planck Institute with a work contract based on the W2 position. It offers 6 years of funding, personnel and materials support, and a subsequent tenure-track option for a permanent associate professorship.
conditional_criteria: Have viable and innovative ideas; Have ideally already had first group leader experience; Have already acted as independent researchers at an early stage of their scientific careers

name: Ran and Ginny Fiennes Award
summary: The Ran and Ginny Fiennes Award supports humanitarian, scientific or educational projects that follow the Transglobe Expedition's tradition of challenge and perseverance. It is designed to support the next generation of emerging travelers and expeditioners. Grants are historically given for between £2,000 and £5,000.
documents_required: application

name: Clinical Research Funding Scheme
summary: This modular scheme provides flexible funding for high-quality clinical trials, experimental medicine, and sample collection. It is open to investigator-led researchers at any career stage based at UK institutions.
documents_required: expression of interest; outline application; full application

name: Postdoctoral Fellowship at the Danish Institute at Athens
summary: This postdoctoral fellowship supports researchers hosted at the Danish Institute at Athens and administered by a Danish research institution. The funding covers salary and related project expenses, with provisions for parental leave, sick leave, and budget reallocations.
conditional_criteria: If the PhD degree has not been obtained at the time of application deadline, a copy of the final PhD assessment must be submitted before the start of the project.
documents_required: Final PhD assessment; Scientific and financial reports

name: Conference and Workshop Grant
summary: This grant program supports meetings and events that promote the development of inclusive communities of anthropologists and advance significant and innovative research. It provides up to $20,000 for conferences and workshops organized by scholars holding a doctorate in anthropology or a related field.
conditional_criteria: Graduate students may act as co-organizers, but must be listed as co-applicants.; Primary aim of multidisciplinary meetings must be to advance anthropological conversations.; Annual conferences organized by national associations are not eligible.; Panels or sessions that are part of larger meetings are not eligible.; Workshops open to students, auditors, and other individuals not sharing work or acting as discussants are not eligible.
documents_required: online application forms; resubmission statement (if applicable)

name: Ralph E. Powe Junior Faculty Enhancement Awards
summary: The Ralph E. Powe Junior Faculty Enhancement Awards provide seed money for full-time assistant professors at ORAU member institutions within two years of their tenure track appointment. The award amount provided by ORAU is $5,000, which must be matched by the applicant's institution with at least an additional $5,000.
conditional_criteria: Only two nominations are allowed per institution.

name: Early Detection and Diagnosis Project Award
summary: The Early Detection and Diagnosis Project Award by Cancer Research UK funds exceptional science to drive transformational change in how and when early cancers and pre-cancerous states are detected and diagnosed. The award supports projects for up to 4 years with funding up to £500k, welcoming researchers at all career stages based at UK institutions.
conditional_criteria: In most cases, the applicant must be fully funded by the host institution for the duration of the award.; If an early career researcher is lead or joint lead applicant, it is strongly recommended to include at least one established researcher as co-applicant for mentorship.; If the applicant receives core funding from a CRUK institute, they may apply as a joint lead applicant with an external researcher.; One lead applicant, joint lead applicant or co-investigator can apply for their salary if they are an early- to mid-career researcher.
documents_required: research proposal; CV; publication list; Skills and Experience form

name: Religion, Spirituality, and Democratic Renewal Program
summary: This program supports research that examines how religion and spirituality shape democratic systems of government or significant democratic movements. It offers funding ranging from $8,000 to $18,000 for doctoral candidates and postdoctoral researchers or eligible professional researchers.
conditional_criteria: Applicants working as professional researchers or university faculty without the PhD outside of the United States may be eligible if they are not concurrently enrolled in an MA program and are within five years of the commencement of their profession
documents_required: application materials; curriculum vitae

name: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Graduate Scholarship
summary: The Hong Kong Jockey Club Graduate Scholarship supports permanent residents of Hong Kong to pursue master's or doctoral degrees at six top-notch universities worldwide. The scholarship covers full tuition and provides a stipend or living allowance.

name: Early Detection and Diagnosis Primer Award
summary: This award supports highly novel and innovative research ideas and pilot studies of high scientific risk to stimulate and develop the early detection and diagnosis of cancer. It provides up to £100k for up to one year to researchers based in UK institutions.
conditional_criteria: If an early career researcher is lead or joint lead applicant, we would strongly recommend including at least one established researcher as co-applicant for mentorship.; If you receive core funding from one of our institutes, you may apply as a joint lead applicant with a researcher based outside the institute.; Postdoctoral researchers applying for a salary whilst under academic supervision must provide a letter of support from your supervisor.
documents_required: Justification appendix; Narrative CV; Skills and experience form; Declaration of competing interests; Letters of support; Research declarations; Data sharing plan; Costs; Other funding declaration; Association of Medical Research Charities full economic costing

name: JASSO Scholarship for Short-term Study in Japan
summary: The JASSO Scholarship for Short-term Study in Japan supports international exchange students accepted by Hitotsubashi University under a partner university agreement. The grant provides a monthly stipend of 80,000 yen for short-term study periods of up to one year.
conditional_criteria: Taiwanese nationals are given the eligibility to apply for the JASSO scholarship since the academic year 2013-14 and are also eligible to apply for a scholarship from JTEA.

name: JASSO Honors Scholarship for Newly Arriving International Students
summary: The JASSO Honors Scholarship provides financial support to privately financed international students with excellent academic performance who enroll in Master's or Doctoral courses at NAIST. The scholarship offers JPY 48,000 per month for a duration of 6 to 12 months depending on the enrollment term.
conditional_criteria: If the applicant has a financial supporter residing in Japan, the supporter's annual income must be less than JPY 5 million.
